    整数加法的良定义性

    2 道练习 · 2 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · add_shift 定理

    搬运律说：把两个和里的加数重新配对，值不变。这正是把 (a+c)+(b+d) 与 (a+b)+(c+d) 对上的那一步。

    theorem add_shift (a b c d : Nat) :
    Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d) =
    Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
    (add_assoc a c (Nat.add b d))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) = Nat.add a m)
        (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d) (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)) (add_assoc c b d))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add c (Nat.add b d)))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))
        (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d) = Nat.add a (Nat.add m d))
          (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add b c)
          (add_comm c b)
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) d))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d) = Nat.add a m)
            (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d) (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d))
            (add_assoc b c d)
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add c d))
            (Nat.add a (Nat.add b (Nat.add c d)))
            (add_assoc a b (Nat.add c d))))))
    练习 2 · addRep_wd 定理

    结论：加法尊重差相等。这里证的是第二个因子 (c,d) 固定、第一个因子换代表元； 另一个因子固定的那一半同理，不在本单元展开。

    theorem addRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b' d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
    (add_shift a b' c d)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add c d))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d) = Nat.add m (Nat.add c d))
        (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add c d))))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' c) (Nat.add b d))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add c d))
        (add_shift a' b c d)))

    整数加法的交换律与结合律

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · add_zero 定理

    先把右零元证出来：a+0 用交换律换成 0+a，再用 zero_add。

    theorem add_zero (a : Nat) :
    Nat.add a Nat.zero = a :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (Nat.add Nat.zero a) a
    (add_comm a Nat.zero)
    (zero_add a)
    练习 2 · addRep_comm 定理

    代表元上的交换律：两个分量各用一次 ℕ 的 add_comm。

    theorem addRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add c a) (Nat.add b d))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b) = Nat.add (Nat.add a c) m)
      (Nat.add d b) (Nat.add b d) (add_comm d b)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add d b))))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d) = Nat.add m (Nat.add b d))
      (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add c a) (add_comm a c)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) (Nat.add b d))))
    练习 3 · addRep_assoc 定理
    theorem addRep_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
           (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                   (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add m (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a c) e) (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e))
        (add_assoc a c e))
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) m)
      (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add b d) f) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f))
        (add_assoc b d f))
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (Nat.add c e)) (Nat.add b (Nat.add d f)))))
    练习 4 · int_add_comm 定理

    搬到商上：把代表元关系交给 Quot.sound，商里的相等就得到了。

    theorem int_add_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
    (addRep_comm a b c d)
    练习 5 · int_add_assoc 定理
    theorem int_add_assoc (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
                (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (addRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
            (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)))
    (addRep_assoc a b c d e f)

    整数加法的零元与负元

    7 道练习 · 7 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · zero_rep 定理

    代表元上的零元：两个 +0 分别用 add_zero 消掉。

    theorem zero_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) b)
    (Nat.add a b)
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (m : Nat) =>
        Nat.add m b = Nat.add a b)
      (Nat.add a Nat.zero) a (add_zero a)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) b)))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero)) (Nat.add a b)
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) =>
          Nat.add a m = Nat.add a b)
        (Nat.add b Nat.zero) b (add_zero b)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (Nat.add b Nat.zero)))))
    练习 2 · int_add_zero 定理

    商上的零元：把 zero_rep 交给 Quot.sound，商里的相等就得到了。

    theorem int_add_zero (a b : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
    (zero_rep a b)
    练习 3 · negRep_wd 定理

    取负尊重差相等：把 h 的两边交换，再各用一次 ℕ 的交换律。

    theorem negRep_wd (a b a' b' : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add b a')
    (Nat.add a' b)
    (Nat.add b' a)
    (add_comm b a')
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add b' a)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add b' a) (Nat.add a b') (add_comm b' a)))
    练习 4 · add_neg_rep 定理

    代表元上的逆元：两个分量 a+b 与 b+a 要证与 (0,0) 差相等。

    theorem add_neg_rep (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) Nat.zero)
    (Nat.add a b)
    (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a))
    (add_zero (Nat.add a b))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add b a) (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a))
      (add_comm a b)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add Nat.zero (Nat.add b a)) (Nat.add b a)
        (zero_add (Nat.add b a))))
    练习 5 · int_add_neg 定理

    商上的逆元：把 add_neg_rep 交给 Quot.sound。

    theorem int_add_neg (a b : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
    (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (add_neg_rep a b)
    练习 6 · negRep_neg 定理

    取负的对合：negRep 交换两个分量，做两次回到 (a,b)。

    theorem negRep_neg (a b : Nat) :
    negRep (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) = @prod_mk Nat Nat a b :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)
    练习 7 · int_neg_neg 定理

    商上的对合律：两个代表元定义性相等，商里的点也相等。

    theorem int_neg_neg (a b : Nat) :
    @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel
        (negRep (negRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))) =
      @Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=

    整数减法的良定义性与基本律

    7 道练习 · 7 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · subRep_wd 定理
    theorem subRep_wd (a b c d a' b' c' d' : Nat)
    (h1 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b'))
    (h2 : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :
    intRel (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d')) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add b' c'))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
    (add_shift a b' d c')
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c') = Nat.add m (Nat.add d c'))
        (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b) h1
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add d c'))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d' c))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a' d') (Nat.add b c))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c') = Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) m)
          (Nat.add d c') (Nat.add d' c)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add d c') (Nat.add c' d) (Nat.add d' c)
            (add_comm d c')
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add c' d) (Nat.add c d') (Nat.add d' c)
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add c d') (Nat.add c' d) h2)
              (add_comm c d')))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.add d c'))))
        (add_shift a' d' b c)))
    练习 2 · subRep_add_rep 定理
    theorem subRep_add_rep (a b c d : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (subRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
                   (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) c) b)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))
    (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
    (add_assoc (Nat.add a d) c b)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add b c))
      (Nat.add a (Nat.add (Nat.add b c) d))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) = Nat.add (Nat.add a d) m)

    整数乘法的良定义性

    3 道练习 · 3 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · mul_add 定理

    先证分配律：(a+b)·c = a·c + b·c，对 c 归纳。

    theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n) = Nat.add (Nat.add a b) m)
          (myMul (Nat.add a b) n)
          (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
          ih
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
          (add_shift a b (myMul a n) (myMul b n))))
    c
    练习 2 · mul_shift_c 定理

    有了分配律，等价假设就能「乘开」：h 两边各乘 c 与 d，得到两条可相加的等式。

    theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
    (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
      (mul_add a b' c))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
      (mul_congr a b a' b' c h)
      (mul_add a' b c))
    练习 3 · mulRep_wd 定理

    最后证良定义性：第二个分量固定，p ~ p' 时 p 乘 q 与 p' 乘 q 差相等。

    theorem mulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d : Nat)
    (h : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b')) :
    intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
           (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
             (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
             (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
               (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)) =
          Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) m)
        (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul b' c) (myMul a' d))
        (add_comm (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c)))))
      (add_shift (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
               (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
               (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
          Nat.add m (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
        (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
        (mul_shift_c a b a' b' c h)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                 (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                 (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)) =
            Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) m)
          (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
          (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
            (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
            (add_comm (myMul b d) (myMul a' d))
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
              (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
              (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
              (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d))
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
                (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))
                (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b d))
                (mul_shift_c a b a' b' d h))
              (add_comm (myMul a d) (myMul b' d))))
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c)) (Nat.add (myMul b d) (myMul a' d)))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                   (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)))
            (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
                     (Nat.add (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
            (add_shift (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) (myMul b' d) (myMul a d)))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
            (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d)) =
              Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) m)
            (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
            (add_comm (myMul b c) (myMul a d))
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d)) (Nat.add (myMul b c) (myMul a d))))))))

    theorem leNat_trans (a b c : Nat) (h1 : LeNat a b) (h2 : LeNat b c) : LeNat a c :=
  @LeNat.rec (fun (m n : Nat) (_ : LeNat m n) => LeNat a m → LeNat a n)
    (fun (n : Nat) => fun (h : LeNat a n) => h)
    (fun (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) (ih : LeNat a m → LeNat a n) =>
       fun (h1 : LeNat a m) => le_succ a n (ih h1))
    b c h2 h1

    练习 1 · nat_add_cancel_right 定理
    theorem nat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat) :
    Nat.add a k = Nat.add b k → a = b :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b)
    (fun (h : a = b) => h)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b) =>
      fun (h : Nat.succ (Nat.add a n) = Nat.succ (Nat.add b n)) =>
        ih (Nat.succ.inj (Nat.add a n) (Nat.add b n) h))
    k
    练习 2 · leNat_exists_add 定理
    theorem leNat_exists_add (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n) :
    ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k :=
  @LeNat.rec
    (fun (m n : Nat) (_ : LeNat m n) =>
      ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k)
    (fun (n : Nat) =>
      Exists.intro Nat.zero (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat n))
    (fun (m n : Nat) (h : LeNat m n)
         (ih : ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k) =>
      Exists.elim ih (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add m k) =>
          Exists.intro (Nat.succ k) (congrArg.{1} Nat.succ hk)))
    m n h
    练习 3 · leNat_self_add 定理

  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => LeNat m (Nat.add m n))
    (le_refl m)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : LeNat m (Nat.add m n)) => le_succ m (Nat.add m n) ih)
    k
    练习 4 · leNat_of_exists_add 定理
    theorem leNat_of_exists_add (m n : Nat)
    (h : ∃ (k : Nat), n = Nat.add m k) :
    LeNat m n :=
  Exists.elim h (fun (k : Nat) (hk : n = Nat.add m k) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat m x) (Nat.add m k) n
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat n (Nat.add m k) hk)
        (leNat_self_add m k))
    练习 5 · leNat_add_cancel_right 定理
    theorem leNat_add_cancel_right (a b k : Nat)
    (h : LeNat (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k)) : LeNat a b :=
  leNat_of_exists_add a b
    (Exists.elim (leNat_exists_add (Nat.add a k) (Nat.add b k) h) (fun (j : Nat)
           (hj : Nat.add b k = Nat.add (Nat.add a k) j) =>
        Exists.intro j (nat_add_cancel_right b (Nat.add a j) k
            (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add b k) (Nat.add (Nat.add a k) j)
              (Nat.add (Nat.add a j) k)
              hj
              (add_rotate a k j)))))

    theorem leRep_wd (a b a1 b1 c d c1 d1 : Nat)
    (hpp : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1))
    (hqq : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) →
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1) :=
  fun (hl : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) =>
    leRep_wd_snd a1 b1 c d c1 d1 (intRel_to_eq c d c1 d1 hqq)
      (leRep_wd_fst a b a1 b1 c d (intRel_to_eq a b a1 b1 hpp) hl)

    theorem leRep_wd_iff (a b a1 b1 c d c1 d1 : Nat)
    (hpp : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1))
    (hqq : intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) :
    (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1)) ∧
        (leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a1 b1) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c1 d1) →
         leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :=
  And.intro
    (leRep_wd a b a1 b1 c d c1 d1 hpp hqq)
    (leRep_wd a1 b1 a b c1 d1 c d
      (intRel_symm a b a1 b1 hpp)
      (intRel_symm c d c1 d1 hqq))

    练习 1 · leRep_trans 定理
    theorem leRep_trans (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h1 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (h2 : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) :
    leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) :=
  leNat_add_cancel_right (Nat.add a f) (Nat.add e b) d
    (leNat_trans (Nat.add (Nat.add a f) d) (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b)
      (Nat.add (Nat.add e b) d)
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f) (Nat.add (Nat.add a f) d) (add_rotate a d f)
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f) x)
          (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) f) (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b) (add_rotate c b f)
          (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) f h1)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add c f) b) x)
        (Nat.add (Nat.add e d) b) (Nat.add (Nat.add e b) d) (add_rotate e d b)
        (leNat_add_right (Nat.add c f) (Nat.add e d) b h2)))
    练习 2 · leRep_add_right 定理
    theorem leRep_add_right (a b c d e f : Nat)
    (h : leRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d)) :
    leRep (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f))
          (addRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
    (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat (Nat.add (Nat.add a e) (Nat.add d f)) x)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add c e) (Nat.add b f))
    (add4 c b e f)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) => LeNat x (Nat.add (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add e f)) (Nat.add (Nat.add a e) (Nat.add d f))
      (add4 a d e f)
      (leNat_add_right (Nat.add a d) (Nat.add c b) (Nat.add e f) h))

    练习 1 · succ_mul 定理
    theorem succ_mul (a b : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.succ a) b = Nat.add (myMul a b) b :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.succ a) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) n)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) Nat.zero) Nat.zero (Nat.add (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero) Nat.zero (add_zero (myMul a Nat.zero))))
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : myMul (Nat.succ a) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) n) =>
      @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.succ a) m =
        Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (myMul a n) n) (myMul (Nat.succ a) n)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) n) (Nat.add (myMul a n) n) ih)
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.succ a) (Nat.add (myMul a n) n))
          (Nat.succ (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
          (succ_add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n))
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
            (Nat.succ (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)))
            (Nat.succ (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n))
            (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.succ n))
            (congrArg.{1} Nat.succ
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n)
                (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a n) n)) (add_assoc a (myMul a n) n)))
            (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.succ (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) n))))))
    b
    练习 2 · myMul_comm 定理
    theorem myMul_comm (a b : Nat) :
    myMul a b = myMul b a :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul a n = myMul n a)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul a Nat.zero) Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero a)
      (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul Nat.zero a) Nat.zero (zero_mul a)))
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul a n = myMul n a) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (myMul (Nat.succ n) a)
          (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add a (myMul n a)) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a)
            (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add a x) ih)
            (add_comm a (myMul n a)))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.succ n) a) (Nat.add (myMul n a) a) (succ_mul n a))))
    b
    练习 3 · mulRep_comm 定理
    theorem mulRep_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
      (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat x (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul b d))
        (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b d)) (myMul_comm a c))
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul c a) y) (myMul_comm b d))))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (y : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat (Nat.add (myMul c a) (myMul d b)) y)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
        (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
        (Nat.add (myMul c b) (myMul d a))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul b c))
          (Nat.add (myMul d a) (myMul c b))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (myMul b c)) (myMul_comm a d))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) => Nat.add (myMul d a) y) (myMul_comm b c)))
        (add_comm (myMul d a) (myMul c b))))

    theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul (Nat.add a b) c = Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b c) :=
  Nat.rec
    (fun (n : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat) (ih : myMul (Nat.add a b) n = Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
        (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
          (fun (m : Nat) => myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n) = Nat.add (Nat.add a b) m)
          (myMul (Nat.add a b) n)
          (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n))
          ih
          (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul (Nat.add a b) (Nat.succ n))))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a (myMul a n)) (Nat.add b (myMul b n)))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add a b) (Nat.add (myMul a n) (myMul b n)))
          (add_shift a b (myMul a n) (myMul b n))))

    theorem mul_shift_c (a b a' b' c : Nat)
    (h : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b) :
    Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c) =
    Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c) :=

    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
    (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b' c))
      (mul_add a b' c))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') c)
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) c)
      (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b c))
      (mul_congr a b a' b' c h)
      (mul_add a' b c))

    (fun (n : Nat) => Nat.add a n = Nat.add b n → a = b)
    (fun (h : a = b) => h)

    (Nat.add (Nat.add a d) f)

    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat r) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))

      (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))

        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat r)) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))

    theorem mul_add (a b c : Nat) :
    myMul a (Nat.add b c) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a c) :=
  Nat.rec (fun (n : Nat) => myMul a (Nat.add b n) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n))
    (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (myMul a b))
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : myMul a (Nat.add b n) = Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n)) =>
      @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul a (Nat.add b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
        (@Eq.refl.{1} Nat (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n))))
        (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
          (Nat.add a (myMul a (Nat.add b n)))
          (Nat.add a (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a n)))
          (Nat.add (myMul a b) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
          (congrArg.{1} (fun (m : Nat) => Nat.add a m) ih)
          (add_mid a (myMul a b) (myMul a n))))
    c

      (myMul c (Nat.add a b))

    练习 1 · mulRep_assoc_fst 定理
    theorem mulRep_assoc_fst (a b c d e f : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) e)
               (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) f) =
      Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d)) e)
             (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c)) f))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) e) (myMul (myMul b d) e))
             (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) f) (myMul (myMul b c) f)))
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
             (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
    (fst_expand_left a b c d e f)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a c) e) (myMul (myMul b d) e))
               (Nat.add (myMul (myMul a d) f) (myMul (myMul b c) f)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T2 b d e))
               (Nat.add (T3 a d f) (T4 b c f)))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
               (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
      (fst_normalize a b c d e f)
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T2 b d e))
                 (Nat.add (T3 a d f) (T4 b c f)))
        (Nat.add (Nat.add (T1 a c e) (T3 a d f))
                 (Nat.add (T4 b c f) (T2 b d e)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
                 (myMul b (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e))))
        (fst_shift a b c d e f)
        (Eq.symm (fst_expand_right a b c d e f))))

    (fun (h : Nat.add a Nat.zero = Nat.zero) => @Eq.refl.{1} Nat Nat.zero)
    (fun (n : Nat)
         (ih : Nat.add a n = Nat.zero → n = Nat.zero) =>

    (fun (m : Nat)

    练习 2 · mulRep_den_mid 定理

    把「两边都乘上同一正分母」的等价假设化成一条 ℕ 加法等式。

    theorem mulRep_den_mid (u v : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))) :
    Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)) =
      Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)) :=
  intRel_trans
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
    (mulRep u (den n))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
    (intRel_symm (mulRep u (den n))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
      (mulRep_den u n))
    (intRel_trans (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
      h (mulRep_den v n))
    练习 3 · mulRep_den_cancel 定理

    正分母可消去：mulRep u (n+1,0) ~ mulRep v (n+1,0) ⇒ u ~ v。

    theorem mulRep_den_cancel (u v : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep u (den n)) (mulRep v (den n))) :
    intRel u v :=
  mul_cancel_pos n
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v)) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
      (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
        (mulRep_den_mid u v n h)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u)) (Nat.succ n))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Nat.succ n))
                   (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))
          (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat v) (Prod.snd Nat Nat u) (Nat.succ n)))))

    theorem mulRep_den_den (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den a) (den b))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero) :=
  @Eq.symm.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
             (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ b))))
    (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
               (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ b))))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
               (Nat.add Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
      (congrArg.{1} (fun (y : Nat) =>
          Nat.add (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) (Nat.add Nat.zero y))

    练习 5 · mulRep_den_comm 定理

    两个正分母的乘积可交换。

    theorem mulRep_den_comm (a b : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den a) (den b)) (mulRep (den b) (den a)) :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep (den a) (den b))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
    (mulRep (den b) (den a))
    (mulRep_den_den a b)
    (intRel_trans
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b)) Nat.zero)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ b) (Nat.succ a)) Nat.zero)
      (mulRep (den b) (den a))
      (myMul_comm (Nat.succ a) (Nat.succ b))
      (intRel_symm (mulRep (den b) (den a))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ b) (Nat.succ a)) Nat.zero)
        (mulRep_den_den b a)))
    练习 6 · ratRel_trans 定理
    theorem ratRel_trans (a b c d e f : Nat) (m n k : Nat)
    (h1 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n))
    (h2 : ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) n)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k)) :
    ratRel
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) m)
      (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) k) :=
  mulRep_den_cancel
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den k))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m))
    n
    (intRel_trans
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den k)) (den n))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den k))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
      (mulRep_den_swap a b k n)
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den k))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den k))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
        (mulRep_wd
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)))
          (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)))
          (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)))
          (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)))
          (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero h1)
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den k))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
          (mulRep_den_swap c d m k)
          (intRel_trans
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)) (den m))
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)) (den m))
            (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den m)) (den n))
            (mulRep_wd
              (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)))
              (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den k)))
              (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)))
              (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat e f) (den n)))
              (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero h2)
            (mulRep_den_swap e f n m)))))

    练习 1 · ratDenRep_succ 定理
    theorem ratDenRep_succ (m n : Nat) :
    Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n) = myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
    (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
    (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n))
      (congrArg.{1} (fun (x : Nat) => Nat.add x (Nat.succ n))
        (mul_add m n (Nat.succ Nat.zero))))
    (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n))
      (Nat.add (myMul m (Nat.succ n)) (Nat.succ n))
      (succ_mul m (Nat.succ n)))
    练习 2 · ratAdd_cross 定理
    theorem ratAdd_cross (a b a' b' : Nat) (m : Nat)
    (h : intRel (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m))
                (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m))) :
    Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b :=
  mul_cancel_pos m (Nat.add a b') (Nat.add a' b)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul (Nat.add a b') (Nat.succ m))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b' (Nat.succ m)))
      (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
      (mul_add_right a b' (Nat.succ m))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b' (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a' (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
        (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
        (mulRep_den_mid (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') m h)
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add a' b) (Nat.succ m))
          (Nat.add (myMul a' (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
          (mul_add_right a' b (Nat.succ m)))))

      (myMul

    theorem ratMul_den (x y : ratRep) :
    denOf (ratMulRep x y) =
    ratDenRep (denOf x) (denOf y) :=
  Eq.refl (ratDenRep (denOf x) (denOf y))
    练习 2 · ratMul_num_comm 定理
    theorem ratMul_num_comm (a b c d : Nat) :
    mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) =
      mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) :=

    练习 1 · ratMulRep_wd 定理
    theorem ratMulRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m)) :
    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a' b' m) (qrep c d n)) :=
  mulRep_wd
    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
    (Nat.add (myMul a' c) (myMul b' d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a' d) (myMul b' c))

    (mulRep_wd a b a' b' c d (rat_cross a b a' b' m h))

    ratRel (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n))
           (ratMulRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n)) :=

    (Nat.add (myMul a c) (myMul b d))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d) (myMul b c))
    (Nat.add (myMul a c') (myMul b d'))
    (Nat.add (myMul a d') (myMul b c'))
    (Nat.succ (ratDenRep m n)) Nat.zero
    (mulRep_wd_snd c d c' d' a b (rat_cross c d c' d' n h))

    练习 1 · negRep_mulRep_den 定理
    theorem negRep_mulRep_den (p : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) :
    negRep (mulRep p (den n)) = mulRep (negRep p) (den n) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (negRep (mulRep p (den n)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
      (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
    (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (negRep (mulRep p (den n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (Eq.refl (negRep (mulRep p (den n))))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (fun (y : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat
            (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))) y)
        (Eq.symm (zero_add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n)))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat x
            (Nat.add Nat.zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
        (zero_add (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ n))))
      (Eq.refl (mulRep (negRep p) (den n))))

      (mulRep (negRep (numOf x)) (den (denOf y)))
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
        (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
        (mulRep (negRep (numOf x)) (den (denOf y)))
        (negRep_mulRep_den (numOf x) (denOf y))))
    (@intRel_trans
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf x) (den (denOf y))))
      (negRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))

      (intRel_of_eq
        (negRep (mulRep (numOf y) (den (denOf x))))

    序与正分母：乘法、消去与配对搬运

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · mulRep_den_form 定理
    theorem mulRep_den_form (p : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat) :
    mulRep p (den k) =
      @prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (mulRep p (den k))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat
      (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
    (Eq.refl (mulRep p (den k)))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) Nat.zero))
        (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat x
            (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
        (add_zero (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat (Prod Nat Nat)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) Nat.zero) (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (fun (y : Nat) =>
          @prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)) y)
        (zero_add (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))))
    练习 2 · mul_den_swap_nat 定理

    ㊲.2 正分母的交换律：(a·m)·k = (a·k)·m

    theorem mul_den_swap_nat (a m k : Nat) :
    myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (Nat.succ k) =
      myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (Nat.succ k))
    (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
    (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
    (myMul_assoc a (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m)))
      (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
      (@congrArg.{1} Nat Nat
        (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k))
        (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m))
        (fun (x : Nat) => myMul a x)
        (myMul_comm (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (myMul (myMul a (Nat.succ k)) (Nat.succ m))
        (myMul a (myMul (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m)))
        (myMul_assoc a (Nat.succ k) (Nat.succ m))))
    练习 3 · prod_mk_congr 定理

    ㊲.3 序对逐坐标相等

    theorem prod_mk_congr (a a' b b' : Nat) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat a' b' :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Nat
    (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat x b')
    a a' ha
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (y : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat a b = @prod_mk Nat Nat a y)
      b b' hb
      (@Eq.refl.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)))
    练习 4 · leRep_mul_den_right 定理

    ㊲.4 乘正分母保序

    theorem leRep_mul_den_right (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep p q) :
    leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k)) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
    (mulRep p (den k))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                      (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
    (mulRep q (den k))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mulRep p (den k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (mulRep p (den k))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mulRep_den_form p k)))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                        (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mulRep q (den k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) (mulRep q (den k))
        (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                          (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mulRep_den_form q k)))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                         (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k)) x)
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
        (leNat_mul_right (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
                         (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
                         (Nat.succ k) h)))
    练习 5 · leRep_cancel_den 定理

    ㊲.5 正分母可消去

    theorem leRep_cancel_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h : leRep (mulRep p (den k)) (mulRep q (den k))) : leRep p q :=
  leNat_mul_cancel
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
    (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) k
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k)))
      (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
               (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (Nat.succ k))
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
        (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                         (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))) x)
        (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                 (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
        (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
          (myMul (Nat.add (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)) (Nat.succ k))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                   (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
          (mul_add_right (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep p (den k))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                            (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
          (mulRep q (den k))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                            (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
          (intRel_of_eq (mulRep p (den k))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k))
                              (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat p) (Nat.succ k)))
            (mulRep_den_form p k))
          (intRel_of_eq (mulRep q (den k))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k))
                              (myMul (Prod.snd Nat Nat q) (Nat.succ k)))
            (mulRep_den_form q k))
          h)))

    有理数的序：传递性

    3 道练习 · 3 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · mulRep_den_perm 定理

    x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ z ⟹ x ≤ z

    theorem mulRep_den_perm (p : Prod Nat Nat) (m k : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (mulRep p (den m)) (den k))
           (mulRep (mulRep p (den k)) (den m)) :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    intRel_trans
      (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den m)) (den k))
      (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
      (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
      (mulRep_assoc a b (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero)
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
        (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
        (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
        (intRel_of_eq
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den m) (den k)))
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
          (congrArg
            (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) => mulRep (prod_mk a b) x)
            (mulRep_comm (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero)))
        (intRel_symm
          (mulRep (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (den k)) (den m))
          (mulRep (prod_mk a b) (mulRep (den k) (den m)))
          (mulRep_assoc a b (Nat.succ k) Nat.zero (Nat.succ m) Nat.zero)))
    练习 2 · ratLeRep_trans 定理
    theorem ratLeRep_trans (x y z : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep x y) (h2 : ratLeRep y z) : ratLeRep x z :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (leNum x z) (leNum z x) (denOf y)
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
      (mulRep (leNum x z) (den (denOf y)))
      (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x)))
      (mulRep (leNum z x) (den (denOf y)))
      (mulRep_den_perm (numOf x) (denOf y) (denOf z))
      (mulRep_den_perm (numOf z) (denOf y) (denOf x))
      (leRep_trans
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x))))
        (Prod.snd Nat Nat (mulRep (leNum z y) (den (denOf x))))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z)))
          (mulRep (leNum y z) (den (denOf x)))
          (intRel_refl (mulRep (leNum x y) (den (denOf z))))
          (mulRep_den_perm (numOf y) (denOf x) (denOf z))
          (leRep_mul_den_right (leNum x y) (leNum y x) (denOf z) h1))
        (leRep_mul_den_right (leNum y z) (leNum z y) (denOf x) h2)))

    ratLeRep ratZeroRep (qrep 3 0 3) :=
  ratLeRep_trans ratZeroRep (qrep 1 0 1) (qrep 3 0 3)
    (le_succ Nat.zero Nat.zero (le_refl Nat.zero))
    (le_succ 4 5 (le_succ 4 4 (le_refl 4)))

    练习 1 · scale_den 定理

    ratLeRep x y :⟺ x.num · (y.den) ≤ y.num · (x.den)

    theorem scale_den (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (n : Nat) (h : intRel p q) :
    intRel (mulRep p (den n)) (mulRep q (den n)) :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
    (fun (y : Prod Nat Nat) =>
      intRel (mulRep p (den n)) (mulRep y (den n)))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
    q
    (Prod.eta Nat Nat q)
    (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
      (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) =>
        intRel (mulRep x (den n))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)) (den n)))
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
      p
      (Prod.eta Nat Nat p)
      (mulRep_wd
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p)
        (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)
        (Nat.succ n) Nat.zero
        (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
          (fun (y : Prod Nat Nat) =>
            intRel
              (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
              y)
          q
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
          (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q))
            q
            (Prod.eta Nat Nat q))
          (@Eq.subst.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
            (fun (x : Prod Nat Nat) =>
              intRel x (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat q) (Prod.snd Nat Nat q)))
            p
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
            (@Eq.symm.{1} (Prod Nat Nat)
              (@prod_mk Nat Nat (Prod.fst Nat Nat p) (Prod.snd Nat Nat p))
              p
              (Prod.eta Nat Nat p))
            h))))
    练习 2 · ratLeRep_wd 定理
    theorem ratLeRep_wd (a b a' b' c d m m' n : Nat)
    (hxx' : ratRel (qrep a b m) (qrep a' b' m'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a' b' m') (qrep c d n) :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m'))
    m
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den m'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den m'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m')) (den m))
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den m'))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m')) (den n))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
        (mulRep_den_swap a b n m')
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m')) (den n))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m)) (den n))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den n)) (den m))
          (scale_den (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den m'))
                     (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a' b') (den m)) n hxx')
          (mulRep_den_swap a' b' m n)))
      (mulRep_den_swap c d m m')
      (leRep_mul_den_right
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
        m' h))
    练习 3 · ratLeRep_wd_snd 定理
    theorem ratLeRep_wd_snd (a b c d c' d' m n n' : Nat)
    (hyy' : ratRel (qrep c d n) (qrep c' d' n'))
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c' d' n') :=
  leRep_cancel_den
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n'))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m))
    n
    (leRep_wd_pair
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n)) (den n'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n')) (den n))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den n'))
      (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
      (mulRep_den_swap a b n n')
      (intRel_trans
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m)) (den n'))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n')) (den m))
        (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
        (mulRep_den_swap c d m n')
        (intRel_trans
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n')) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den n)) (den m))
          (mulRep (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den m)) (den n))
          (scale_den (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den n'))
                     (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c' d') (den n)) m hyy')
          (mulRep_den_swap c' d' n m)))
      (leRep_mul_den_right
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
        (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
        n' h))

    实数的相等：自反性

    3 道练习 · 3 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · cauchy_close_self 定理

    realRel x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (y n) eps Real := Quot realRel

    theorem cauchy_close_self (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (x n) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps h)
      (fun (N : Nat) (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m → close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) => hN n n hn hn))
    练习 2 · realRel_refl 定理
    theorem realRel_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realRel x x :=
  And.intro hx (And.intro hx (cauchy_close_self x hx))
    练习 3 · demo_realRel_refl 定理
    theorem demo_realRel_refl : realRel zeroSeq zeroSeq :=
  realRel_refl zeroSeq cauchy_zero

    theorem ratLeRep_neg_lit (a b c d m n : Nat)
    (h : ratLeRep (qrep a b m) (qrep c d n)) :
    ratLeRep (qrep d c n) (qrep b a m) :=
  leRep_wd_pair
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) (den m))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
    (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) (den n))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) (den m))
      (Eq.symm (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat d c) m)))
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
      (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) (den n))
      (Eq.symm (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat b a) n)))
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
      (fun (x : Nat) =>
        LeNat x (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m))))
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
      (add_comm (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Nat
        (fun (x : Nat) =>
          LeNat (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))) x)
        (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (add_comm (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (leRep_wd_pair
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
          (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
          (intRel_of_eq
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) (den n))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
            (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) n))
          (intRel_of_eq
            (mulRep (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) (den m))
            (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m)))
            (mulRep_den_form (@prod_mk Nat Nat c d) m))
          h)))

    theorem close_symm (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close y x eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
         (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratSubRep y x)
            d

              (ratSubRep y x)
              (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))

          (And.right hd)))

      (ratDenRep m n) :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} ratRep
    (qrep
      (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
      (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
      (ratDenRep n m))
    (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n))))
      (ratDenRep m n))
    (@prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))
        (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul d (Nat.succ m))))
      (ratDenRep m n))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (dd : Nat) =>
        @prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat
            (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
            (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n))))
          dd)
      (ratDenRep_comm n m))
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (p : Prod Nat Nat) =>
        @prod_mk (Prod Nat Nat) Nat p (ratDenRep m n))
      (prod_mk_congr
        (Nat.add (myMul c (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ n)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))

        (Nat.add (myMul d (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ n)))
        (ratDenRep n m))

      (fun (z : ratRep) =>

        (ratDenRep m n))

              (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul c (Nat.succ m)))

    补充 · ratAbsRel_wd_left_aux 定理
    theorem ratAbsRel_wd_left_aux (u v : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) (d : ratRep) :
    ratRel u v → ratAbsRel u d → ratAbsRel v d :=
  match u with
  | prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m =>
    match v with
    | prod_mk (prod_mk a' b') m' =>
      fun (h : ratRel (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m) (prod_mk (prod_mk a' b') m'))
          (hab : ratAbsRel (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m) d) =>
        Or.elim
          (fun (h1 : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m) ∧
                     ratRel d (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m)) =>
            Or.inl (And.intro
              (ratLeRep_congr_snd Nat.zero Nat.zero a b a' b' Nat.zero m m'
                h (And.left h1))
              (ratRel_trans_gen d (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m)
                (prod_mk (prod_mk a' b') m') (And.right h1) h)))
          (fun (h2 : ratLeRep (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m) ratZeroRep ∧
                     ratRel d (ratNegRep (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m))) =>
            Or.inr (And.intro
              (ratLeRep_congr a b a' b' Nat.zero Nat.zero m m' Nat.zero
                h (And.left h2))
              (ratRel_trans_gen d (ratNegRep (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m))
                (ratNegRep (prod_mk (prod_mk a' b') m'))
                (And.right h2)
                (ratNegRep_wd (prod_mk (prod_mk a b) m)
                  (prod_mk (prod_mk a' b') m') h))))
          hab

    theorem realRel_close_symm (x y : Seq)
    (h : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (y n) (x n) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (h eps he)
      (fun (N : Nat)
           (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            close_symm (x n) (y n) eps (hN n hn)))

    有理数加法的代表元律：交换与零元

    6 道练习 · 6 份按名匹配的解答 · 2 个解答独有声明

    练习 1 · ratAdd_zero_num 定理

    (a-b)/(m+1) + (c-d)/(n+1) = [a(n+1)+c(m+1) - (b(n+1)+d(m+1))] / ((m+1)(n+1)) 为什么需要它们：下一单元的「序与加法相容」要把 x ≤ y 搬到 x + z ≤ y + z， 而左加（z + x ≤ z + y）靠的是「先交换、用右加、再交换回来」—— 没有 ㊸.3 就无法把右加版本变成左加版本。 ㊸.4 先把 x + 0 这个三元组搬成 qrep a b m（㊸.1/㊸.2 消掉零项）， 再用 ratRel_refl。ratRep 是 Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat 的定义别名， match 只认归纳类型本身，所以通用陈述先在一个 _aux（展开类型上的） 定理里 match 到字面三元组，再把字面结果转发给通用陈述 —— 这是本课程 处理「ratRep 上的通用引理」的固定写法（㊷ 的 ratSubRep_neg_aux 同形）。 ㊸.6 是具体计算：1/2 + 1/3 的代表元公式定义性归约成 5/6 = qrep 5 0 5， 两边是同一个三元组，直接 ratRel_refl。 ㊸.1 加零的分子形状 myMul a (succ 0) 定义性展开成 a + a*0；a*0 = 0（myMul_zero）后是 a + 0， add_zero 收成 a。另一个加数 0*(m+1) = 0（zero_mul），整个和就是 a。 ㊸.1

    theorem ratAdd_zero_num (a m : Nat) :
    Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)) = a :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
    (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
    a
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add Z (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (myMul a (Nat.succ Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add a (myMul a Nat.zero))
        (Nat.add a Nat.zero)
        (myMul_succ a Nat.zero)
        (congrArg.{1} (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add a Z) (myMul_zero a))))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) (myMul Nat.zero (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
      a
      (congrArg.{1}
        (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Z)
        (zero_mul (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add (Nat.add a Nat.zero) Nat.zero)
        (Nat.add a Nat.zero)
        a
        (add_zero (Nat.add a Nat.zero))
        (add_zero a)))

    theorem ratAdd_zero_den (m : Nat) : ratDenRep m Nat.zero = m :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Nat
    (ratDenRep m Nat.zero)
    (Nat.add (Nat.add Nat.zero m) Nat.zero)
    m
    (congrArg.{1}
      (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add (Nat.add Z m) Nat.zero)
      (myMul_zero m))
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (Nat.add Nat.zero m) Nat.zero)
      (Nat.add m Nat.zero)
      m
      (congrArg.{1}
        (fun (Z : Nat) => Nat.add Z Nat.zero)
        (zero_add m))
      (add_zero m))

                 (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n m)))
          (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul q (Nat.succ m)))
                 (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n m))))

          (numOf (ratAddRep (qrep p q n) (qrep a b m)))
          (den (denOf (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep p q n)))))

          (mulRep
            (numOf (ratAddRep (qrep a b m) (qrep p q n)))
            (den (denOf (ratAddRep (qrep p q n) (qrep a b m)))))
          (@prod_mk Nat Nat
            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ n)) (myMul p (Nat.succ m)))

            (myMul (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ n)) (myMul q (Nat.succ m)))
                   (Nat.succ (ratDenRep n m))))

    theorem ratAdd_zero_aux (x : Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep x ratZeroRep) x :=

    序与加法相容：x ≤ y ⇒ x + z ≤ y + z

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答 · 7 个解答独有声明

    练习 1 · mulRep_add 定理

    a(n+1) + d(m+1) ≤ c(m+1) + b(n+1) （h） ㊹.1 先证 mulRep 对 addRep 的分配律（分子层面的展开）；；㊹.2 把 den (ratDenRep m n) 换成 mulRep (den m) (den n) （分母层面的乘积），两个正分母就能搬到最外层；；㊹.3 证 addRep 保 intRel（把两个加数的等价搬运拼起来）；；㊹.4 主定理：把 leNum 层层化到「h 两边乘 (k+1)」，再用 ㊲ 的 leRep_mul_den_right / leRep_add_right 收口。 写法提醒：ratRep 是 Prod (Prod Nat Nat) Nat 的定义别名，match 只认 归纳类型本身；所以通用包装（㊹ 的 _gen 系列）都先 match 到字面坐标再 转发给 lib/Rat 里只有字面坐标版本的引理 —— 与 ㊷/㊸ 的 _aux 同一写法。

    theorem mulRep_add (p q r : Prod Nat Nat) :
    mulRep (addRep p q) r = addRep (mulRep p r) (mulRep q r) :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    match q with
    | prod_mk c d =>
      match r with
      | prod_mk e f =>
        prod_mk_congr
          (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add a c) e) (myMul (Nat.add b d) f))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a e) (myMul b f))
                   (Nat.add (myMul c e) (myMul d f)))
          (Nat.add (myMul (Nat.add a c) f) (myMul (Nat.add b d) e))
          (Nat.add (Nat.add (myMul a f) (myMul b e))
                   (Nat.add (myMul c f) (myMul d e)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_congr (mul_add_right a c e) (mul_add_right b d f))
            (add4 (myMul a e) (myMul c e) (myMul b f) (myMul d f)))
          (Eq.trans
            (add_congr (mul_add_right a c f) (mul_add_right b d e))
            (add4 (myMul a f) (myMul c f) (myMul b e) (myMul d e)))
    练习 2 · mulRep_den_den_gen 定理
    theorem mulRep_den_den_gen (m n : Nat) :
    intRel (mulRep (den m) (den n)) (den (ratDenRep m n)) :=
  intRel_trans
    (mulRep (den m) (den n))
    (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero)
    (den (ratDenRep m n))
    (mulRep_den_den m n)
    (intRel_of_eq
      (@prod_mk Nat Nat (myMul (Nat.succ m) (Nat.succ n)) Nat.zero)
      (den (ratDenRep m n))
      (Eq.symm
        (congrArg (fun (x : Nat) => @prod_mk Nat Nat x Nat.zero)
          (ratDenRep_succ m n))))
    练习 3 · intRel_add 定理
    theorem intRel_add (p p' q q' : Prod Nat Nat) :
    intRel p p' → intRel q q' → intRel (addRep p q) (addRep p' q') :=
  match p with
  | prod_mk a b =>
    match p' with
    | prod_mk a' b' =>
      match q with
      | prod_mk c d =>
        match q' with
        | prod_mk c' d' =>
          fun (h1 : Nat.add a b' = Nat.add a' b)
              (h2 : Nat.add c d' = Nat.add c' d) =>
            Eq.trans
              (Eq.symm (add4 a b' c d'))
              (Eq.trans
                (add_congr h1 h2)
                (add4 a' b c' d))

      (mulRep (mulRep (leNum y x) (den (denOf z))) (den (denOf z)))

      (leNum (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep y z))

             (ratAddRep (qrep 1 0 1) (qrep 1 0 1)) :=
