          (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
          Nat.zero)))
    (lhs0_eq a b m)
    (@Eq.trans.{1} Nat
      (Nat.add (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
      (Nat.add
        (Nat.add Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (Nat.add Nat.zero
          (Nat.add
            (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
            Nat.zero)))
      (add_comm (myMul a (Nat.succ m)) (myMul b (Nat.succ m)))
      (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat
        (Nat.add
          (Nat.add Nat.zero Nat.zero)
          (Nat.add Nat.zero
            (Nat.add
              (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
              Nat.zero)))
        (Nat.add (myMul b (Nat.succ m)) (myMul a (Nat.succ m)))
        (rhs0_eq a b m)))

    两次减法的相加：中间项消去

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratAddRep_wd_gen 定理

    证明路线（全部停在商 + 已证明的库引理上，不碰 funext、不加公理）： ratAddRep_wd_gen / ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen：ratRel 对 ratAddRep 的两个变元都是同余（库里的 ratAddRep_wd / _snd 只认字面三元组， 这里用 ㊴ 的 ratLeRep_congr_gen + ㊹ 的加法单调 + ㊻ 的反对称性 在任意代表元上补出通用版本）；；ratNegRep_add_self：(-y) + y ~ 0（㉚–㉟ 的交换律 + 55 的逆元律）；；ratSubRep_add：结合律把 (x + -y) + (y + -z) 收成 x + ((-y + y) + -z)，中间项换成 0，再用左零元收尾；；demo_sub_add：(1/2 - 1/3) + (1/3 - 1/4) ~ 1/2 - 1/4。 我们不引入新定义；ratSubRep 是 ㉜ 的减法定义。 库里的 ratAddRep_wd 只认字面三元组（两个变元必须同分母）。任意代表元上 用序来补：x ~ x' 给两个方向的弱序，各加同一个 z（㊹ 的 ratLeRep_add_right）， 再用 ㊻ 的反对称性把两条弱序夹成 ratRel。

    theorem ratAddRep_wd_gen (x x' z : ratRep) (h : ratRel x x') :
    ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z) :=
  ratLeRep_antisymm (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x' z)
    (ratLeRep_add_right x x' z (ratLeRep_of_ratRel x x' h))
    (ratLeRep_add_right x' x z
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel x' x (ratRel_symm x x' h)))
    练习 2 · ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen 定理
    theorem ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (x z z' : ratRep) (h : ratRel z z') :
    ratRel (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x z') :=
  ratLeRep_antisymm (ratAddRep x z) (ratAddRep x z')
    (ratLeRep_add_left z z' x (ratLeRep_of_ratRel z z' h))
    (ratLeRep_add_left z' z x
      (ratLeRep_of_ratRel z' z (ratRel_symm z z' h)))
    练习 3 · ratNegRep_add_self 定理

    55 给的是 y + (-y) ~ 0；交换两个加数即可。这条是中间项消去的引擎。

    theorem ratNegRep_add_self (y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) ratZeroRep :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y)
    (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y))
    ratZeroRep
    (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep y) y)
    (ratAdd_neg_gen y)
    练习 4 · ratSubRep_add 定理

    四步链（中间项 -y + y 换成 0）： (x + -y) + (y + -z) ~ x + (-y + (y + -z)) 结合律 ~ x + ((-y + y) + -z) 结合律（反向） ~ x + (0 + -z) 中间项消去 ~ x + -z 左零元

    theorem ratSubRep_add (x y z : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) (ratSubRep x z) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
    (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z))))
    (ratSubRep x z)
    (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z))))
      (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z)))
      (ratSubRep x z)
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
        (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
        (ratRel_symm
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep z)))
          (ratAdd_assoc (ratNegRep y) y (ratNegRep z))))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z)))
        (ratSubRep x z)
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratNegRep y) y) ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z)
            (ratNegRep_add_self y)))
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen x
          (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratNegRep z))
          (ratNegRep z)
          (ratAdd_zero_left (ratNegRep z)))))
    练习 5 · demo_sub_add 定理
    theorem demo_sub_add :
    ratRel
      (ratAddRep
        (ratSubRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 2))
        (ratSubRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 2) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 3)))
      (ratSubRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 3)) :=
  ratSubRep_add (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 2) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 3)

    close 的传递性：两个 ε/2 的界加起来

    4 道练习 · 4 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratLtRep_congr_snd 定理

    close x y eps :⟺ ∃ d, |x - y| ~ d ∧ d < eps ① |x - z| 与 |(x - y) + (y - z)| 是同一个数的两个见证 （56 的 ratSubRep_add 把 (x - y) + (y - z) 认成 x - z， 再用 ㊷ 的 ratAbsRel_wd_left 搬过去）； ② 三角不等式（㊽ 的 ratLeRep_abs_add）给出 d ≤ dx + dy； ③ dx < ε/2 与 dy < ε/2 加起来是 dx + dy < ε（51 的两个严格界相加， 再用 52 的 ε/2 + ε/2 ~ ε 把右端搬成 ε）。 我们不引入新定义；用到的前序事实证明已收进 lib/RatClose。 ratLtRep a b 是 ratLeRep a b ∧ ¬ ratRel a b：弱序沿 b ~ c 搬 （㊴ 的 ratLeRep_congr_gen），不相等部分把 a ~ c 与 c ~ b 串成 a ~ b。

    theorem ratLtRep_congr_snd (a b c : ratRep)
    (h : ratLtRep a b) (hbc : ratRel b c) : ratLtRep a c :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen a a b c (ratRel_refl a) hbc (And.left h))
    (fun (hac : ratRel a c) =>
      And.right h
        (ratRel_trans_gen a c b hac (ratRel_symm b c hbc)))
    练习 2 · ratAdd_lt_half 定理

    51 的 ratLtRep_add 先给 dx + dy < ε/2 + ε/2；52 的 ratHalf_add_self 把右端认成 ε，再用 57.1 搬过去。

    theorem ratAdd_lt_half (dx dy eps : ratRep)
    (hx : ratLtRep dx (ratHalf eps)) (hy : ratLtRep dy (ratHalf eps)) :
    ratLtRep (ratAddRep dx dy) eps :=
  ratLtRep_congr_snd
    (ratAddRep dx dy)
    (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
    eps
    (ratLtRep_add dx (ratHalf eps) dy (ratHalf eps) hx hy)
    (ratHalf_add_self eps)
    练习 3 · close_trans 定理

    展开两个 close 得见证 dx、dy；用 ㊺ 的 ratAbsRel_total 给 (x - y) + (y - z) 取一个见证 d，三角不等式给 d ≤ dx + dy， 绝对值的第一分量沿 56 的 ratSubRep_add 搬到 x - z。

    theorem close_trans (x y z eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps)
    (hxy : close x y (ratHalf eps)) (hyz : close y z (ratHalf eps)) :
    close x z eps :=
  Exists.elim hxy
    (fun (dx : ratRep)
        (hdx : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) dx ∧ ratLtRep dx (ratHalf eps)) =>
      Exists.elim hyz
        (fun (dy : ratRep)
            (hdy : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep y z) dy ∧ ratLtRep dy (ratHalf eps)) =>
          Exists.elim
            (ratAbsRel_total
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)))
            (fun (d : ratRep)
                (hd : ratAbsRel
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z)) d) =>
              Exists.intro d
                (And.intro
                  (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
                    (ratSubRep x z)
                    d
                    (ratSubRep_add x y z)
                    hd)
                  (ratLtRep_of_le_lt d (ratAddRep dx dy) eps
                    (ratLeRep_abs_add
                      (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z) dx dy d
                      (And.left hdx) (And.left hdy) hd)
                    (ratAdd_lt_half dx dy eps
                      (And.right hdx) (And.right hdy)))))))
    练习 4 · demo_close_trans 定理

    0 < 2 的弱序是 leNat_zero_le，不相等把 0 ~ 2 化成 0 = 2 后交给 succ_ne_zero；半数 0 < 1 由 53 的 ratLtRep_half 给出。

    theorem demo_close_trans :
    close ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero) :=
  close_trans ratZeroRep ratZeroRep ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
    (And.intro
      (leNat_zero_le 2)
      (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
        succ_ne_zero 1
          (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))
    (close_zero_zero (ratHalf (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratLtRep_half (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (And.intro
          (leNat_zero_le 2)
          (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
            succ_ne_zero 1
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))))
    (close_zero_zero (ratHalf (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (ratLtRep_half (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
        (And.intro
          (leNat_zero_le 2)
          (fun (h : ratRel ratZeroRep (qrep 2 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) =>
            succ_ne_zero 1
              (@Eq.symm.{1} Nat Nat.zero (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) h)))))

    实数的相等：传递性

    4 道练习 · 4 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · leNat_max 定理

    realRel x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, close (x n) (y n) eps Cauchy x —— 直接是 hxy 的第一分量；；Cauchy z —— 直接是 hyz 的第二分量；；逐点 close —— 这里的内容。 leNat_total 给出 m ≤ n 或 n ≤ m：前者取 N = n（n ≤ n 是构造子 LeNat.le_refl），后者取 N = m，再用 leNat_trans 把 n ≤ m 搬到 m ≤ m。

    theorem leNat_max (m n : Nat) : ∃ (N : Nat), LeNat m N ∧ LeNat n N :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (h : LeNat m n) =>
      Exists.intro n (And.intro h (LeNat.le_refl n)))
    (fun (h : LeNat n m) =>
      Exists.intro m (And.intro (LeNat.le_refl m) h))
    (leNat_total m n)
    练习 2 · realRel_close_trans 定理

    对 ε/2 取两个阈值，用 58.1 合并成 N；在 n ≥ N 上，两个前提各自 通过 leNat_trans 落到 n，再交给 close_trans。

    theorem realRel_close_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (hxy : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps)
    (hyz : ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (y n) (z n) eps) :
    ∀ (eps : ratRep), ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps →
      ∃ (N : Nat), ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (z n) eps :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hxy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (N1 : Nat)
          (h1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n → close (x n) (y n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hyz (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N2 : Nat)
              (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n → close (y n) (z n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
              (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                Exists.intro N
                  (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                    close_trans (x n) (y n) (z n) eps heps
                      (h1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                      (h2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))))
    练习 3 · realRel_trans 定理

    三元组逐分量拼装：两个 Cauchy 分量来自 hxy / hyz，第三分量是 58.2。

    theorem realRel_trans (x y z : Seq) (hxy : realRel x y) (hyz : realRel y z) :
    realRel x z :=
  And.intro
    (And.left hxy)
    (And.intro
      (And.left (And.right hyz))
      (realRel_close_trans x y z
        (And.right (And.right hxy))
        (And.right (And.right hyz))))
    练习 4 · demo_realRel_trans 定理

    两次 realRel_zero（㊱ 已证明）就是传递性的两个前提。

    theorem demo_realRel_trans : realRel zeroSeq zeroSeq :=
  realRel_trans zeroSeq zeroSeq zeroSeq realRel_zero realRel_zero

    实数的取负：第一次把运算下降到商上

    6 道练习 · 6 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratSubRep_neg_neg 定理

    (-x) - (-y) 是 -x + -(-y)。用 ㉛ 的对合把 -(-y) 换成 y （ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen），再用 ㊸ 的交换律把 -x + y 换成 y + -x （即 y - x），最后接上 ㊷ 的 ratSubRep_neg。

    theorem ratSubRep_neg_neg (x y : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
           (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
    (ratSubRep y x)
    (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep (ratNegRep y)))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x) y)
      (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x))
      (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep (ratNegRep y)) y
        (ratNegRep_invol y))
      (ratAdd_comm (ratNegRep x) y))
    (ratSubRep_neg x y)
    练习 2 · close_neg 定理

    取出 |x - y| ~ d 的见证 d。先用 ㊶ 的 ratAbsRel_neg_gen 把绝对值 搬到 |-(x - y)|，再用 59.1（取对称）沿 ratAbsRel_wd_left 搬到 |(-x) - (-y)|；d < eps 原样。

    theorem close_neg (x y eps : ratRep) (h : close x y eps) :
    close (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y) eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      Exists.intro d
        (And.intro
          (ratAbsRel_wd_left
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
            d
            (ratRel_symm
              (ratSubRep (ratNegRep x) (ratNegRep y))
              (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
              (ratSubRep_neg_neg x y))
            (ratAbsRel_neg_gen (ratSubRep x y) d (And.left hd)))
          (And.right hd)))
    练习 3 · cauchy_neg 定理

    对每个 n m ≥ N 调用 59.2；量词结构原样保留。

    theorem cauchy_neg (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : Cauchy (negSeq x) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
           (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m → close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
            close_neg (x n) (x m) eps (hN n m hn hm)))
    练习 4 · realRel_neg 定理

    两个 Cauchy 分量由 59.3 给出；第三分量逐点用 59.2。

    theorem realRel_neg (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) :
    realRel (negSeq x) (negSeq y) :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_neg x (And.left h))
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_neg y (And.left (And.right h)))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (realRel_close x y h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
               (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                close_neg (x n) (y n) eps (hN n hn)))))
    练习 5 · Real.neg_mk 定理

    Real.neg (Real.mk x) 展开成 Quot.lift f … (Quot.mk x)，ι 归约直接给出 f x = Real.mk (negSeq x)，所以是 Eq.refl。

    theorem Real.neg_mk (x : Seq) :
    Real.neg (Real.mk x) = Real.mk (negSeq x) :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} Real (Real.mk (negSeq x))
    练习 6 · demo_real_neg 定理

    negSeq zeroSeq 与 zeroSeq 定义性相同（-(0/1) = 0/1），所以 realRel_refl 就够；两段分别是 59.5 与 Real.sound。

    theorem demo_real_neg : Real.neg (Real.mk zeroSeq) = Real.mk zeroSeq :=
  @Eq.trans.{1} Real
    (Real.neg (Real.mk zeroSeq))
    (Real.mk (negSeq zeroSeq))
    (Real.mk zeroSeq)
    (Real.neg_mk zeroSeq)
    (Real.sound (negSeq zeroSeq) zeroSeq (realRel_refl zeroSeq cauchy_zero))

    实数的加法：下降之前的两条义务

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratSubRep_add_sub 定理

    五步链：① -(x'+y') ~ -x' + -y'（㊽.4 的 ratNegRep_add，右端同余）； ② 结合律反向，把 (x+y) + (-x' + -y') 拆成 ((x+y) + -x') + -y'； ③ 内层结合律把 (x+y) + -x' 换成 x + (y + -x')； ④ 交换 y + -x' 成 -x' + y，再结合成 (x + -x') + y； ⑤ 最后一步结合律收成 (x + -x') + (y + -y')。

    theorem ratSubRep_add_sub (x x' y y' : ratRep) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
           (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')) :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
    (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
    (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
      (ratAddRep x y)
      (ratNegRep (ratAddRep x' y'))
      (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y'))
      (ratNegRep_add x' y'))
    (ratRel_trans_gen
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
      (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                 (ratNegRep y'))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
      (ratRel_symm
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y)
                   (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
        (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x') (ratNegRep y')))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
                   (ratNegRep y'))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
        (ratAddRep_wd_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratNegRep x'))
          (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
          (ratNegRep y')
          (ratAdd_assoc x y (ratNegRep x')))
        (ratRel_trans_gen
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
                     (ratNegRep y'))
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                     (ratNegRep y'))
          (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
          (ratAddRep_wd_gen
            (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x')))
            (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
            (ratNegRep y')
            (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen
              x
              (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep x'))
              (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y)
              (ratAdd_comm y (ratNegRep x'))))
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                       (ratNegRep y'))
            (ratAddRep (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
                       (ratNegRep y'))
            (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
            (ratAddRep_wd_gen
              (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
              (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
              (ratNegRep y')
              (ratRel_symm
                (ratAddRep (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y)
                (ratAddRep x (ratAddRep (ratNegRep x') y))
                (ratAdd_assoc x (ratNegRep x') y)))
            (ratAdd_assoc (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep x')) y
              (ratNegRep y'))))))
    练习 2 · close_add 定理

    两个 ε/2 的界 (x - x')、(y - y')，经 60.1 搬到 (x+y) - (x'+y')； ㊽ 的三角不等式把它们加成 dx + dy，57 的 ratAdd_lt_half 收到 ε， 最后 ratLtRep_of_le_lt 夹出结论。

    theorem close_add (x x' y y' eps : ratRep)
    (hx : close x x' (ratHalf eps)) (hy : close y y' (ratHalf eps)) :
    close (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y') eps :=
  Exists.elim hx
    (fun (dx : ratRep)
        (hdx : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x x') dx ∧
               ratLtRep dx (ratHalf eps)) =>
      Exists.elim hy
        (fun (dy : ratRep)
            (hdy : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep y y') dy ∧
                   ratLtRep dy (ratHalf eps)) =>
          Exists.elim
            (ratAbsRel_total
              (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')))
            (fun (d : ratRep)
                (hd : ratAbsRel
                  (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y')) d) =>
              Exists.intro d
                (And.intro
                  (ratAbsRel_wd_left
                    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
                    (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
                    d
                    (ratRel_symm
                      (ratSubRep (ratAddRep x y) (ratAddRep x' y'))
                      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y'))
                      (ratSubRep_add_sub x x' y y'))
                    hd)
                  (ratLtRep_of_le_lt d (ratAddRep dx dy) eps
                    (ratLeRep_abs_add
                      (ratSubRep x x') (ratSubRep y y') dx dy d
                      (And.left hdx) (And.left hdy) hd)
                    (ratAdd_lt_half dx dy eps
                      (And.right hdx) (And.right hdy)))))))
    练习 3 · cauchy_add 定理

    量词结构与 neg 相同，只是要在 ε/2 上同时取两个阈值；58 的 leNat_max 把 N1、N2 合成一个 N，再逐点用 60.2。

    theorem cauchy_add (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    Cauchy (addSeq x y) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
      (fun (N1 : Nat)
          (h1 : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N1 n → LeNat N1 m →
            close (x n) (x m) (ratHalf eps)) =>
        Exists.elim (hy (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N2 : Nat)
              (h2 : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N2 n → LeNat N2 m →
                close (y n) (y m) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
              (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                Exists.intro N
                  (fun (n m : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) (hm : LeNat N m) =>
                    close_add (x n) (x m) (y n) (y m) eps
                      (h1 n m
                        (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn)
                        (leNat_trans N1 N m (And.left hN) hm))
                      (h2 n m
                        (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)
                        (leNat_trans N2 N m (And.right hN) hm))))))
    练习 4 · realRel_add 定理

    三元组逐分量：两个 Cauchy 分量是 60.3；第三分量对 ε/2 取两组阈值， 合并后逐点用 60.2。

    theorem realRel_add (x x' y y' : Seq)
    (hx : realRel x x') (hy : realRel y y') :
    realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq x' y') :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add x y (And.left hx) (And.left hy))
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add x' y'
        (And.left (And.right hx)) (And.left (And.right hy)))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realRel_close x x' hx (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (h1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                close (x n) (x' n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realRel_close y y' hy (ratHalf eps)
                (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (h2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    close (y n) (y' n) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        close_add (x n) (x' n) (y n) (y' n) eps
                          (h1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                          (h2 n
                            (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn))))))))
    练习 5 · demo_add_rep 定理

    ratAddRep_mk 是定义性相等：(1/2) + (1/3) 归约成 qrep 5 0 (ratDenRep 1 2)，而 ratDenRep 1 2 归约成 5；两边就是 同一个 qrep，交给 ratRel_refl。

    theorem demo_add_rep :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (qrep 1 Nat.zero 1) (qrep 1 Nat.zero 2))
           (qrep 5 Nat.zero 5) :=
  ratRel_refl (qrep 5 Nat.zero 5)

    实数的加法：三元关系（存在 + 唯一）

    6 道练习 · 6 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · addRel_mk 定理

    两次 Quot.lift 都按 ι 归约，所以两边是定义性相等的命题， Iff.intro 的两个人射都取恒等函数。

    theorem addRel_mk (x y : Seq) (c : Real) :
    (addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c) ↔ (addRelRep x y c) :=
  Iff.intro (fun (h : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c) => h)
            (fun (h : addRelRep x y c) => h)
    练习 2 · addRel_intro 定理
    theorem addRel_intro (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) :=
  And.intro hx (And.intro hy (Eq.refl (Real.mk (addSeq x y))))
    练习 3 · addRel_sound 定理
    theorem addRel_sound (x y z : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (hz : realRel z (addSeq x y)) :
    addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z) :=
  And.intro hx (And.intro hy (Real.sound z (addSeq x y) hz))
    练习 4 · addRel_unique 定理

    对 a、b 各做一次 Quot.ind；addRel 的两次 ι 归约把两个假设 都变成 c = mk (x+y) 与 c' = mk (x+y)，直接传递。

    theorem addRel_unique (a b c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (h' : addRel a b c') :
    c = c' :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) =>
      ∀ (b c c' : Real), addRel a b c → addRel a b c' → c = c')
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c c' : Real)
          (h : addRel (Real.mk x) b c)
          (h' : addRel (Real.mk x) b c') =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) =>
            ∀ (c c' : Real),
              addRel (Real.mk x) b c → addRel (Real.mk x) b c' → c = c')
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c c' : Real)
                (hc : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c)
                (hc' : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c') =>
              Eq.trans
                (And.right (And.right hc))
                (Eq.symm (And.right (And.right hc'))))
          b c c' h h')
    a b c c' h h'
    练习 5 · addRel_exists_unique 定理
    theorem addRel_exists_unique (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    ∃ (c : Real),
      addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c ∧
        ∀ (c' : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c' → c' = c :=
  Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
    (And.intro
      (addRel_intro x y hx hy)
      (fun (c' : Real) (hc' : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c') =>
        addRel_unique (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c' (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
          hc' (addRel_intro x y hx hy)))
    练习 6 · demo_addRel_zero 定理
    theorem demo_addRel_zero :
    addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq)
      (Real.mk (addSeq zeroSeq zeroSeq)) :=
  addRel_intro zeroSeq zeroSeq cauchy_zero cauchy_zero

    实数的加法：交换律与零元（三元关系版）

    9 道练习 · 9 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratSubRep_ratRel_zero 定理

    先 x - y ~ y - y（加法第一个变元的同余，56 的 ratAddRep_wd_gen）， 再用 55 的逆元律 y + (-y) ~ 0 传递。

    theorem ratSubRep_ratRel_zero (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratRel (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  ratRel_trans_gen
    (ratSubRep x y)
    (ratSubRep y y)
    ratZeroRep
    (ratAddRep_wd_gen x y (ratNegRep y) h)
    (ratAdd_neg_gen y)
    练习 2 · ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel 定理

    取见证 d := 0。ratAbsRel 的定义是两个析取支，按 0 ≤ x-y 与 x-y ≤ 0 二分（㊺ 的 ratLeRep_total）： 非负支：左支要 0 ≤ x-y 与 0 ~ x-y（62.1 调向）；；非正支：右支要 x-y ≤ 0 与 0 ~ -(x-y)。后者由 62.1 经 ratNegRep_wd 搬到 -0，而 -0 与 0 定义性相等 （ratNegRep ratZeroRep 归约成 ratZeroRep），所以 ratRel_refl ratZeroRep 直接收口。

    theorem ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) :
    ratAbsRel (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  Or.elim
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y)) =>
      Or.inl (And.intro hle
        (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
          (ratSubRep_ratRel_zero x y h))))
    (fun (hle : ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep) =>
      Or.inr (And.intro hle
        (ratRel_symm (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y)) ratZeroRep
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratNegRep (ratSubRep x y))
            (ratNegRep ratZeroRep)
            ratZeroRep
            (ratNegRep_wd (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep
              (ratSubRep_ratRel_zero x y h))
            (ratRel_refl ratZeroRep)))))
    (ratLeRep_total ratZeroRep (ratSubRep x y))
    练习 3 · close_of_ratRel 定理

    close x y ε 是 ∃ d, ratAbsRel (x - y) d ∧ d < ε；见证取 d := 0， 第一分量是 62.2，第二分量就是假设 0 < ε。

    theorem close_of_ratRel (x y : ratRep) (h : ratRel x y) (eps : ratRep)
    (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) : close x y eps :=
  Exists.intro ratZeroRep
    (And.intro (ratAbsRel_zero_of_ratRel x y h) heps)
    练习 4 · realRel_add_comm 定理

    两个 Cauchy 分量是 60 的 cauchy_add（两个方向各一次）；第三分量 的阈值取 N := 0（任何 n 都可以），逐点用 ㊸ 的 ratAdd_comm 加 62.3 的桥。

    theorem realRel_add_comm (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    realRel (addSeq x y) (addSeq y x) :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add x y hx hy)
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add y x hy hx)
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            close_of_ratRel (addSeq x y n) (addSeq y x n)
              (ratAdd_comm (x n) (y n)) eps heps)))
    练习 5 · addRel_comm 定理

    对 a、b 各做一次 Quot.ind。进入 mk x、mk y 后，h 的 三次 ι 归约给出 Cauchy x、Cauchy y 与 c = mk (x+y)；目标 addRel (mk y) (mk x) c 要的是 Cauchy y、Cauchy x 与 c = mk (y+x)。前两个分量对调即可，第三个把 c = mk (x+y) 与

    theorem addRel_comm (a b c : Real) (h : addRel a b c) : addRel b a c :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => ∀ (b c : Real), addRel a b c → addRel b a c)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c : Real) (hxbc : addRel (Real.mk x) b c) =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) => ∀ (c : Real),
            addRel (Real.mk x) b c → addRel b (Real.mk x) c)
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c : Real) (hxy : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c) =>
              And.intro
                (And.left (And.right hxy))
                (And.intro
                  (And.left hxy)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (And.right (And.right hxy))
                    (Real.sound (addSeq x y) (addSeq y x)
                      (realRel_add_comm x y (And.left hxy)
                        (And.left (And.right hxy)))))))
          b c hxbc)
    a b c h
    练习 6 · realRel_add_zero 定理

    第一分量是 60 的 cauchy_add（第二个因子用 ㉟ 的 cauchy_zero）， 第二分量是 hx 本身；第三分量取 N := 0，逐点用 ㊸ 的 ratAdd_zero 加 62.3 的桥。

    theorem realRel_add_zero (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    realRel (addSeq x zeroSeq) x :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add x zeroSeq hx cauchy_zero)
    (And.intro hx
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            close_of_ratRel (addSeq x zeroSeq n) (x n)
              (ratAdd_zero (x n)) eps heps)))
    练习 7 · addRel_zero_right 定理

    进入 mk x 后，addRel (mk x) (mk 0) (mk x) 要 Cauchy x、 Cauchy 0 与 mk x = mk (x+0)；最后一条是 62.6 经 Real.sound 再调向。

    theorem addRel_zero_right (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk x) :=
  And.intro hx
    (And.intro cauchy_zero
      (Eq.symm (Real.sound (addSeq x zeroSeq) x
        (realRel_add_zero x hx))))
    练习 8 · addRel_zero_left 定理
    theorem addRel_zero_left (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk x) (Real.mk x) :=
  addRel_comm (Real.mk x) (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk x)
    (addRel_zero_right x hx)
    练习 9 · demo_addRel_zero_seq 定理
    theorem demo_addRel_zero_seq :
    addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) :=
  addRel_zero_right zeroSeq cauchy_zero

    实数的加法：结合律（三元关系版）

    4 道练习 · 4 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · realRel_add_assoc 定理

    addRel a b s → addRel s c t → ∃ u, addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t 63.1 代表元层：(x+y)+z ~ x+(y+z)（㉔ 的 ratAdd_assoc 经 62 的 close_of_ratRel 逐点搬到 realRel）；；63.2 mk 层：已知 (x+y)+z = t，取 u := mk (y+z)，把 63.3 商层：对 a、b、c 各做一次 Quot.ind，用 63.2。 两个 Cauchy 分量各是两次 60 的 cauchy_add；第三分量取 N := 0， 逐点用㉔的 ratAdd_assoc 加 62 的 close_of_ratRel。

    theorem realRel_add_assoc (x y z : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (hz : Cauchy z) :
    realRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z)) :=
  And.intro
    (cauchy_add (addSeq x y) z (cauchy_add x y hx hy) hz)
    (And.intro
      (cauchy_add x (addSeq y z) hx (cauchy_add y z hy hz))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            close_of_ratRel (addSeq (addSeq x y) z n)
              (addSeq x (addSeq y z) n)
              (ratAdd_assoc (x n) (y n) (z n)) eps heps)))
    练习 2 · addRel_assoc_mk 定理

    见证取 u := mk (y + z)。 addRel (mk y) (mk z) u：61 的 addRel_intro，要 Cauchy y（假设） 与 Cauchy z（从 h 的第二个守卫）；；addRel (mk x) u t：Cauchy x 是假设，Cauchy (y+z) 是 cauchy_add，第三分量是 t = mk ((x+y)+z) = mk (x+(y+z))——后半段由 63.1 经 Real.sound。

    theorem addRel_assoc_mk (x y z : Seq) (t : Real)
    (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y)
    (h : addRel (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (Real.mk z) t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z) u ∧
      addRel (Real.mk x) u t :=
  Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq y z))
    (And.intro
      (addRel_intro y z hy (And.left (And.right h)))
      (And.intro
        hx
        (And.intro
          (cauchy_add y z hy (And.left (And.right h)))
          (Eq.trans
            (And.right (And.right h))
            (Real.sound (addSeq (addSeq x y) z) (addSeq x (addSeq y z))
              (realRel_add_assoc x y z hx hy
                (And.left (And.right h))))))))
    练习 3 · addRel_assoc 定理

    对 a、b、c 各做一次 Quot.ind。进入 mk x、mk y、mk z 后， h1 的 ι 归约给出 s = mk (x+y)；把它代进 h2（Eq.subst）得到 addRel (mk (x+y)) (mk z) t，正好是 63.2 的前提。

    theorem addRel_assoc (a b c s t : Real)
    (h1 : addRel a b s) (h2 : addRel s c t) :
    ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) =>
      ∀ (b c s t : Real), addRel a b s → addRel s c t →
        ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel a u t)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      fun (b c s t : Real)
          (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) b s) (h2 : addRel s c t) =>
        @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
          (fun (b : Real) =>
            ∀ (c s t : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) b s → addRel s c t →
              ∃ (u : Real), addRel b c u ∧ addRel (Real.mk x) u t)
          (fun (y : Seq) =>
            fun (c s t : Real)
                (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s) (h2 : addRel s c t) =>
              @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
                (fun (c : Real) =>
                  ∀ (s t : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s →
                    addRel s c t →
                    ∃ (u : Real), addRel (Real.mk y) c u ∧ addRel (Real.mk x) u t)
                (fun (z : Seq) =>
                  fun (s t : Real)
                      (h1 : addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) s)
                      (h2 : addRel s (Real.mk z) t) =>
                    (fun (h2' : addRel (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (Real.mk z) t) =>
                      addRel_assoc_mk x y z t
                        (And.left h1) (And.left (And.right h1)) h2')
                    (@Eq.subst.{1} Real
                      (fun (s' : Real) => addRel s' (Real.mk z) t)
                      s (Real.mk (addSeq x y))
                      (And.right (And.right h1)) h2))
                c s t h1 h2)
          b c s t h1 h2)
    a b c s t h1 h2
    练习 4 · demo_addRel_assoc 定理
    theorem demo_addRel_assoc :
    ∃ (u : Real),
      addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) u ∧
        addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) u (Real.mk zeroSeq) :=
  addRel_assoc
    (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq)
    (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq)
    (addRel_zero_right zeroSeq cauchy_zero)
    (addRel_zero_right zeroSeq cauchy_zero)

    实数的序：代表元关系与自反性

    3 道练习 · 3 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · realLeRep_refl 定理

    前两个分量都是 hx；第三分量取 N := 0，逐点把 x n - x n 认成 0 （55 的 ratAdd_neg_gen，ratSubRep 就是 x + (-x)），再用 ratLtRep_le 把 0 < eps 投成 0 ≤ eps。

    theorem realLeRep_refl (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) : realLeRep x x :=
  And.intro hx
    (And.intro hx
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.intro Nat.zero
          (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
            ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (x n) (x n)) ratZeroRep eps
              (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratSubRep (x n) (x n)) ratZeroRep
                (ratAdd_neg_gen (x n)))
              (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep eps heps))))
    练习 2 · realLeRep_of_realRel 定理

    两个 Cauchy 分量直接取 h。第三分量对 eps 直接用 realRel 的 接近性（不必折半）：它给见证 d 使 |x n - y n| ~ d 且 d < eps； ratAbsRel_le 把绝对值压成 x n - y n ≤ d，ratLtRep_le 把 d < eps 投成 d ≤ eps，再传递。

    theorem realLeRep_of_realRel (x y : Seq) (h : realRel x y) : realLeRep x y :=
  And.intro (And.left h)
    (And.intro (And.left (And.right h))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim (realRel_close x y h eps heps)
          (fun (N : Nat)
              (hN : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N n → close (x n) (y n) eps) =>
            Exists.intro N
              (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                Exists.elim (hN n hn)
                  (fun (d : ratRep)
                      (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d ∧
                            ratLtRep d eps) =>
                    ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d eps
                      (ratAbsRel_le (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d (And.left hd))
                      (ratLtRep_le d eps (And.right hd)))))))
    练习 3 · demo_realLe_zero 定理
    theorem demo_realLe_zero : realLeRep zeroSeq zeroSeq :=
  realLeRep_of_realRel zeroSeq zeroSeq realRel_zero

    实数的序：传递性

    3 道练习 · 3 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratLeRep_sub_add 定理

    realLeRep x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n - y n) ≤ eps x ≤ y → y ≤ z → x ≤ z 56 的 ratSubRep_add：(x - y) + (y - z) ~ x - z；；52 的 ratHalf_add_self：eps/2 + eps/2 ~ eps；；51 的 ratLtRep_half：0 < eps ⇒ 0 < eps/2。 65.1 ratLeRep_sub_add —— 代表元层的拼装件；；65.2 realLeRep_trans —— 序的传递性；；65.3 常零序列上的具体例。 ratLeRep_add 先把两个界加成 (x-y)+(y-z) ≤ eps+eps；左边用 56 的 ratSubRep_add 换成 x-z，右边不动（ratRel_refl），交给 ratLeRep_congr_gen。

    theorem ratLeRep_sub_add (x y z eps : ratRep)
    (h1 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) eps)
    (h2 : ratLeRep (ratSubRep y z) eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x z) (ratAddRep eps eps) :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep x y) (ratSubRep y z))
    (ratSubRep x z)
    (ratAddRep eps eps) (ratAddRep eps eps)
    (ratSubRep_add x y z)
    (ratRel_refl (ratAddRep eps eps))
    (ratLeRep_add (ratSubRep x y) eps (ratSubRep y z) eps h1 h2)
    练习 2 · realLeRep_trans 定理

    两个 Cauchy 守卫直接取 h1、h2 的第一/第三分量。对 eps 用 ratLtRep_half 得到 0 < eps/2，两个前提各取阈值 N1、N2，用 leNat_max 合成 N；在 n ≥ N 上用 65.1 得 x n - z n ≤ eps/2 + eps/2，再沿 ratHalf_add_self 搬到 eps。

    theorem realLeRep_trans (x y z : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y z) : realLeRep x z :=
  And.intro (And.left h1)
    (And.intro (And.left (And.right h2))
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realLeRep_close x y h1 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realLeRep_close y z h2 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (y n) (z n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        ratLeRep_congr_gen
                          (ratSubRep (x n) (z n))
                          (ratSubRep (x n) (z n))
                          (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
                          (ratRel_refl (ratSubRep (x n) (z n)))
                          (ratHalf_add_self eps)
                          (ratLeRep_sub_add (x n) (y n) (z n) (ratHalf eps)
                            (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                            (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)))))))))
    练习 3 · demo_realLe_trans 定理
    theorem demo_realLe_trans : realLeRep zeroSeq zeroSeq :=
  realLeRep_trans zeroSeq zeroSeq zeroSeq
    (realLeRep_refl zeroSeq cauchy_zero)
    (realLeRep_refl zeroSeq cauchy_zero)

    实数的序：沿 realRel 下降成 Real 上的关系

    4 道练习 · 4 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · realLeRep_wd 定理

    realLeRep x y :⟺ Cauchy x ∧ Cauchy y ∧ ∀ eps > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n - y n) ≤ eps realLe : Real → Real → Prop 66.0 realLeRep_wd —— 换左因子，序不变；；66.1 realLeRep_wd_snd —— 换右因子，序不变；；66.2 realLeY —— 固定左因子，对第二个因子做 Quot.lift；；66.3 realLe —— 对第一个因子再做一次 Quot.lift；；66.4 realLe_mk —— 两次 lift 的 ι 规则；；66.5 常零序列上的具体例。

    theorem realLeRep_wd (x x' y : Seq) (hx : realRel x x') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x' y :=
  @Iff.intro (realLeRep x y) (realLeRep x' y)
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x' x y
        (realLeRep_of_realRel x' x (realRel_symm x x' hx))
        h)
    (fun (h : realLeRep x' y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x x' y
        (realLeRep_of_realRel x x' hx)
        h)
    练习 2 · realLeRep_wd_snd 定理
    theorem realLeRep_wd_snd (x y y' : Seq) (hy : realRel y y') :
    realLeRep x y ↔ realLeRep x y' :=
  @Iff.intro (realLeRep x y) (realLeRep x y')
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y) =>
      realLeRep_trans x y y' h
        (realLeRep_of_realRel y y' hy))
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y') =>
      realLeRep_trans x y' y h
        (realLeRep_of_realRel y' y (realRel_symm y y' hy)))
    练习 3 · realLe_mk 定理

    两次 Quot.lift 都按 ι 归约，所以两边是定义性相等的命题， Iff.intro 的两个人射都取恒等函数。

    theorem realLe_mk (x y : Seq) :
    realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) ↔ realLeRep x y :=
  @Iff.intro (realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y)) (realLeRep x y)
    (fun (h : realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y)) => h)
    (fun (h : realLeRep x y) => h)
    练习 4 · demo_realLe_lift 定理
    theorem demo_realLe_lift : realLe (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) :=
  @Iff.mpr (realLe (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq)) (realLeRep zeroSeq zeroSeq)
    (realLe_mk zeroSeq zeroSeq)
    (realLeRep_of_realRel zeroSeq zeroSeq realRel_zero)

    实数的序：自反、传递、反对称

    7 道练习 · 7 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · ratHalf_lt_self 定理

    realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) ↔ realLeRep x y 自反只在「有 Cauchy 代表元」的实数上成立：Real 是商，商里的 非 Cauchy「杂点」让 realLe 没有输出。所以自反写成代表元形式 realLe (mk x) (mk x)，假设 Cauchy x——不把「每个 Real 都是 Cauchy 类」写成公理。；传递对任意三个实数成立：两个前提本身就是 realLe，经 66 的 ι 规则回到代表元层后，Cauchy 守卫已经由前提付清；接力棒交给 反对称是真正的数学内容：x ≤ y 与 y ≤ x 只给出 x n - y n ≤ eps 与 y n - x n ≤ eps， 要得到 realRel x y 的第三分量（close），必须把两个界折半， 再用绝对值的两分支把 |x n - y n| 夹到 eps 以下。折半之后 还需要 eps/2 < eps 这条严格不等式（52 只给了 0 < eps/2）， 我们用加法消去补上（67.0）。 67.0 ratHalf_lt_self —— 0 < eps ⇒ eps/2 < eps；；67.1 ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds —— 两侧界 < eps ⇒ 绝对值 < eps；；67.2 realLe_refl_mk —— 代表元层的自反；；67.3 realLe_trans —— 传递；；67.4 realLe_antisymm_mk —— 代表元层的反对称（给出 realRel）；；67.5 realLe_antisymm —— 商上的反对称；；67.6 常零序列上的具体例。

    theorem ratHalf_lt_self (eps : ratRep) (h : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) :
    ratLtRep (ratHalf eps) eps :=
  And.intro
    (ratLeRep_congr_gen
      (ratAddRep ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps)) (ratHalf eps)
      (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
      (ratAdd_zero_left (ratHalf eps))
      (ratHalf_add_self eps)
      (ratLeRep_add_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
        (ratLeRep_half_of_lt eps h)))
    (fun (heq : ratRel (ratHalf eps) eps) =>
      (ratLtRep_right ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps h))
        (ratRel_add_cancel_gen ratZeroRep (ratHalf eps) eps
          (ratRel_trans_gen
            (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps)
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
            (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep ratZeroRep eps) eps
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAdd_zero_left eps)
              (ratRel_symm
                (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)) eps
                (ratHalf_add_self eps)))
            (ratRel_trans_gen
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep eps (ratHalf eps))
              (ratAddRep (ratHalf eps) eps)
              (ratAddRep_wd_gen (ratHalf eps) eps (ratHalf eps) heq)
              (ratAdd_comm eps (ratHalf eps))))))
    练习 2 · ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds 定理

    ratAbsRel 是定义别名；Or.elim 的三个显式命题必须写全， 否则推断停在 ratAbsRel z d 上，不会展开成析取。

    theorem ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds (z d b eps : ratRep)
    (hd : ratAbsRel z d)
    (h1 : ratLeRep z b) (h2 : ratLeRep (ratNegRep z) b)
    (hb : ratLtRep b eps) : ratLtRep d eps :=
  @Or.elim
    (ratLeRep ratZeroRep z ∧ ratRel d z)
    (ratLeRep z ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep z))
    (ratLtRep d eps)
    (fun (hl : ratLeRep ratZeroRep z ∧ ratRel d z) =>
      ratLtRep_of_le_lt d b eps
        (ratLeRep_trans d z b
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d z (And.right hl)) h1) hb)
    (fun (hr : ratLeRep z ratZeroRep ∧ ratRel d (ratNegRep z)) =>
      ratLtRep_of_le_lt d b eps
        (ratLeRep_trans d (ratNegRep z) b
          (ratLeRep_of_ratRel d (ratNegRep z) (And.right hr)) h2) hb)
    hd
    练习 3 · realLe_refl_mk 定理
    theorem realLe_refl_mk (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk x) :=
  Iff.mpr (realLe_mk x x) (realLeRep_refl x hx)
    练习 4 · realLe_trans 定理
    theorem realLe_trans (a b c : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b c) : realLe a c :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => realLe a b → realLe b c → realLe a c)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
        (fun (b : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) b → realLe b c → realLe (Real.mk x) c)
        (fun (y : Seq) =>
          @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
            (fun (c : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) → realLe (Real.mk y) c → realLe (Real.mk x) c)
            (fun (z : Seq) (hxy : realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y))
                           (hyz : realLe (Real.mk y) (Real.mk z)) =>
              Iff.mpr (realLe_mk x z)
                (realLeRep_trans x y z
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk x y) hxy)
                  (Iff.mp (realLe_mk y z) hyz)))
            c)
        b)
    a h1 h2
    练习 5 · realLe_antisymm_mk 定理
    theorem realLe_antisymm_mk (x y : Seq)
    (h1 : realLeRep x y) (h2 : realLeRep y x) : realRel x y :=
  And.intro (And.left h1)
    (And.intro (And.left h2)
      (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
        Exists.elim
          (realLeRep_close x y h1 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
          (fun (N1 : Nat)
              (hN1 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N1 n →
                ratLeRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
            Exists.elim
              (realLeRep_close y x h2 (ratHalf eps) (ratLtRep_half eps heps))
              (fun (N2 : Nat)
                  (hN2 : ∀ (n : Nat), LeNat N2 n →
                    ratLeRep (ratSubRep (y n) (x n)) (ratHalf eps)) =>
                Exists.elim (leNat_max N1 N2)
                  (fun (N : Nat) (hN : LeNat N1 N ∧ LeNat N2 N) =>
                    Exists.intro N
                      (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
                        Exists.elim
                          (ratAbsRel_total (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)))
                          (fun (d : ratRep) (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d) =>
                            Exists.intro d
                              (And.intro hd
                                (ratAbsRel_lt_of_bounds
                                  (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)) d (ratHalf eps) eps hd
                                  (hN1 n (leNat_trans N1 N n (And.left hN) hn))
                                  (ratLeRep_congr_gen
                                    (ratSubRep (y n) (x n))
                                    (ratNegRep (ratSubRep (x n) (y n)))
                                    (ratHalf eps) (ratHalf eps)
                                    (ratSubRep_neg (x n) (y n))
                                    (ratRel_refl (ratHalf eps))
                                    (hN2 n (leNat_trans N2 N n (And.right hN) hn)))
                                  (ratHalf_lt_self eps heps))))))))))
    练习 6 · realLe_antisymm 定理
    theorem realLe_antisymm (a b : Real)
    (h1 : realLe a b) (h2 : realLe b a) : a = b :=
  @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
    (fun (a : Real) => realLe a b → realLe b a → a = b)
    (fun (x : Seq) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} Seq realRel
        (fun (b : Real) => realLe (Real.mk x) b → realLe b (Real.mk x) → Real.mk x = b)
        (fun (y : Seq) (hxy : realLe (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y))
                       (hyx : realLe (Real.mk y) (Real.mk x)) =>
          Real.sound x y
            (realLe_antisymm_mk x y
              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk x y) hxy)
              (Iff.mp (realLe_mk y x) hyx)))
        b)
    a h1 h2
    练习 7 · demo_realLe_self 定理
    theorem demo_realLe_self : realLe (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) :=
  realLe_refl_mk zeroSeq cauchy_zero

    完备性：有理 Cauchy 序列在 ℝ 中收敛到自己的类

    7 道练习 · 7 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · cauchy_const 定理

    任意两个位置都相等，x n - x n ~ 0，绝对值取见证 0。

    theorem cauchy_const (q : ratRep) : Cauchy (constSeq q) :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.intro Nat.zero
      (fun (n m : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) (_hm : LeNat Nat.zero m) =>
        Exists.intro ratZeroRep
          (And.intro
            (ratAbsRel_wd_left ratZeroRep (ratSubRep q q) ratZeroRep
              (ratRel_symm (ratSubRep q q) ratZeroRep (ratAdd_neg_gen q))
              ratAbsRel_zero)
            heps))
    练习 2 · cauchy_add_const 定理

    就是 60 的 cauchy_add 用在 x 与常序列 q 上；两个定义在 fun n => x n + q 上定义性相等。

    theorem cauchy_add_const (x : Seq) (q : ratRep) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    Cauchy (addConst x q) :=
  cauchy_add x (constSeq q) hx (cauchy_const q)
    练习 3 · close_sub_le 定理

    close a b eps 给见证 d：|a-b| ~ d 且 d < eps。 ratAbsRel_le 把绝对值压成 a-b ≤ d，ratLtRep_le 把 d < eps 投成 d ≤ eps，再传递。

    theorem close_sub_le (a b eps : ratRep) (h : close a b eps) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps :=
  Exists.elim h
    (fun (d : ratRep)
        (hd : ratAbsRel (ratSubRep a b) d ∧ ratLtRep d eps) =>
      ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep a b) d eps
        (ratAbsRel_le (ratSubRep a b) d (And.left hd))
        (ratLtRep_le d eps (And.right hd)))
    练习 4 · ratLeRep_sub_add_right 定理

    代数恒等式 a - (b + eps) ~ (a - b) - eps： ① -(b + eps) ~ -b + -eps（㊽.4 ratNegRep_add）； ② 右端同余把 a + -(b + eps) 搬成 a + (-b + -eps)； ③ 结合律反向把它认成 (a + -b) + -eps。 序：(a - b) ≤ eps 右加 -eps 得 (a-b) + -eps ≤ eps + -eps ~ 0， 再用 0 ≤ e 传递。最后沿 ①–③ 的等式把结论搬回 a - (b + eps)。

    theorem ratLeRep_sub_add_right (a b eps e : ratRep)
    (h : ratLeRep (ratSubRep a b) eps)
    (he : ratLeRep ratZeroRep e) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps)) e :=
  ratLeRep_congr_gen
    (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
    (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
    e e
    (ratRel_symm
      (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
      (ratRel_trans_gen
        (ratSubRep a (ratAddRep b eps))
        (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep_wd_snd_gen a
          (ratNegRep (ratAddRep b eps))
          (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratNegRep_add b eps))
        (ratRel_symm
          (ratAddRep (ratAddRep a (ratNegRep b)) (ratNegRep eps))
          (ratAddRep a (ratAddRep (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))
          (ratAdd_assoc a (ratNegRep b) (ratNegRep eps)))))
    (ratRel_refl e)
    (ratLeRep_trans
      (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
      ratZeroRep e
      (ratLeRep_trans
        (ratAddRep (ratSubRep a b) (ratNegRep eps))
        (ratAddRep eps (ratNegRep eps))
        ratZeroRep
        (ratLeRep_add_right (ratSubRep a b) eps (ratNegRep eps) h)
        (ratLeRep_of_ratRel
          (ratAddRep eps (ratNegRep eps)) ratZeroRep
          (ratAdd_neg_gen eps)))
      he)
    练习 5 · cauchy_tends_to_class 定理

    对 eps > 0 取 Cauchy 性的阈值 N。固定 n ≥ N 后， 对每个 e > 0： 上界：hN n k 给 x n - x k ≤ eps，68.5 得 x n - (x k + eps) ≤ e；；下界：hN k n 给 x k - x n ≤ eps，68.5 得 x k - (x n + eps) ≤ e。 两条 realLeRep 经 66.4 的 ι 规则送回商上的 realLe。

    theorem cauchy_tends_to_class (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    TendsTo x x :=
  fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
    Exists.elim (hx eps heps)
      (fun (N : Nat)
          (hN : ∀ (n m : Nat), LeNat N n → LeNat N m →
            close (x n) (x m) eps) =>
        Exists.intro N
          (fun (n : Nat) (hn : LeNat N n) =>
            And.intro
              (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (constSeq (x n)) (addConst x eps))
                (And.intro (cauchy_const (x n))
                  (And.intro (cauchy_add_const x eps hx)
                    (fun (e : ratRep) (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e) =>
                      Exists.intro N
                        (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat N k) =>
                          ratLeRep_sub_add_right (x n) (x k) eps e
                            (close_sub_le (x n) (x k) eps (hN n k hn hk))
                            (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep e he))))))
              (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk x (addConst (constSeq (x n)) eps))
                (And.intro hx
                  (And.intro
                    (cauchy_add_const (constSeq (x n)) eps
                      (cauchy_const (x n)))
                    (fun (e : ratRep) (he : ratLtRep ratZeroRep e) =>
                      Exists.intro N
                        (fun (k : Nat) (hk : LeNat N k) =>
                          ratLeRep_sub_add_right (x k) (x n) eps e
                            (close_sub_le (x k) (x n) eps (hN k n hk hn))
                            (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep e he))))))))
    练习 6 · cauchy_has_limit 定理

    极限代表元就是 x 自己；实数层面的极限是 Real.mk x。

    theorem cauchy_has_limit (x : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) :
    ∃ (L : Seq), Cauchy L ∧ TendsTo x L :=
  Exists.intro x (And.intro hx (cauchy_tends_to_class x hx))
    练习 7 · demo_cauchy_limit 定理
    theorem demo_cauchy_limit : TendsTo zeroSeq zeroSeq :=
  cauchy_tends_to_class zeroSeq cauchy_zero

    数系链：从 ℕ 到 ℝ 的保序嵌入

    7 道练习 · 7 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · intToRat_mk 定理

    Quot.lift 作用在 Quot.mk p 上按 ι 归约成 f p，所以是定义性相等。

    theorem intToRat_mk (a b : Nat) :
    intToRat (@Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b)) =
    ratOf (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) Nat.zero :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} Rat (ratOf (@prod_mk Nat Nat a b) Nat.zero)
    练习 2 · natToInt_le 定理

    leRep (n, 0) (m, 0) 展开就是 LeNat (n + 0) (m + 0)；leNat_add_right 把 LeNat n m 右加 0 直接搬过去。

    theorem natToInt_le (n m : Nat) (h : LeNat n m) :
    leRep (natToIntRep n) (natToIntRep m) :=
  leNat_add_right n m Nat.zero h
    练习 3 · intToRat_le 定理

    ratLeRep (p/1) (q/1) 是交叉相乘后的 leRep；「乘正分母保序」 （leRep_mul_den_right）正好把 leRep p q 搬到 den 0 = (1, 0) 上。

    theorem intToRat_le (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (h : leRep p q) :
    ratLeRep (intToRatRep p) (intToRatRep q) :=
  leRep_mul_den_right p q Nat.zero h
    练习 4 · ratLeRep_sub_nonpos 定理

    把 x ≤ y 两边同加 -y（㊹ 的加法相容），右边 y + -y 用 55 的 逆元律收成 0，再用传递性。ratSubRep x y 就是 x + -y 的定义。

    theorem ratLeRep_sub_nonpos (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    ratLeRep (ratSubRep x y) ratZeroRep :=
  ratLeRep_trans (ratAddRep x (ratNegRep y)) (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y)) ratZeroRep
    (ratLeRep_add_right x y (ratNegRep y) h)
    (ratLeRep_of_ratRel (ratAddRep y (ratNegRep y)) ratZeroRep (ratAdd_neg_gen y))
    练习 5 · ratToReal_le 定理

    66 的 ι 规则 realLe_mk 把商上的 realLe 化回代表元层的 realLeRep。 三个分量：两个常序列的 Cauchy 性（68.1），以及逐点的 (constSeq x n) - (constSeq y n) = x - y ≤ 0 ≤ eps。

    theorem ratToReal_le (x y : ratRep) (h : ratLeRep x y) :
    realLe (Real.mk (constSeq x)) (Real.mk (constSeq y)) :=
  Iff.mpr (realLe_mk (constSeq x) (constSeq y))
    (And.intro (cauchy_const x)
      (And.intro (cauchy_const y)
        (fun (eps : ratRep) (heps : ratLtRep ratZeroRep eps) =>
          Exists.intro Nat.zero
            (fun (n : Nat) (_hn : LeNat Nat.zero n) =>
              ratLeRep_trans (ratSubRep (constSeq x n) (constSeq y n)) ratZeroRep eps
                (ratLeRep_sub_nonpos (constSeq x n) (constSeq y n) h)
                (ratLtRep_le ratZeroRep eps heps)))))
    练习 6 · natToReal_le 定理
    theorem natToReal_le (n m : Nat) (h : LeNat n m) :
    realLe (natToReal n) (natToReal m) :=
  ratToReal_le (intToRatRep (natToIntRep n)) (intToRatRep (natToIntRep m))
    (intToRat_le (natToIntRep n) (natToIntRep m) (natToInt_le n m h))
    练习 7 · demo_natToReal_le 定理
    theorem demo_natToReal_le :
    realLe (natToReal 1) (natToReal 3) :=
  natToReal_le 1 3 (le_succ 1 2 (le_succ 1 1 (le_refl 1)))

    数系链：加法在四层间的迁移

    6 道练习 · 6 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · natToInt_add 定理

    addRep (n,0) (m,0) 的两个坐标是 n + m 与 0 + 0；Nat.add 0 0 按定义归约成 0，所以两边是同一个代表元，intRel_refl 收口。

    theorem natToInt_add (n m : Nat) :
    intRel (addRep (natToIntRep n) (natToIntRep m)) (natToIntRep (Nat.add n m)) :=
  intRel_refl (natToIntRep (Nat.add n m))
    练习 2 · intToRat_add 定理

    分母 1 上 ratAddRep 的分子就是 addRep 的两个坐标（乘 1、加 0 都按 定义归约），分母字段仍归约成 0，于是两边是同一个 ratRep。

    theorem intToRat_add (p q : Prod Nat Nat) :
    ratRel (ratAddRep (intToRatRep p) (intToRatRep q))
      (intToRatRep (addRep p q)) :=
  ratRel_refl (intToRatRep (addRep p q))
    练习 3 · ratToReal_add 定理

    addRel_intro 要两个 Cauchy 守卫；常序列的 Cauchy 性是 68.1。 addSeq (constSeq x) (constSeq y) 与 constSeq (ratAddRep x y) 在 fun n => x + y 上定义性相等。

    theorem ratToReal_add (x y : ratRep) :
    addRel (Real.mk (constSeq x)) (Real.mk (constSeq y))
      (Real.mk (constSeq (ratAddRep x y))) :=
  addRel_intro (constSeq x) (constSeq y) (cauchy_const x) (cauchy_const y)
    练习 4 · natToReal_add 定理
    theorem natToReal_add (n m : Nat) :
    addRel (natToReal n) (natToReal m) (natToReal (Nat.add n m)) :=
  ratToReal_add (intToRatRep (natToIntRep n)) (intToRatRep (natToIntRep m))
    练习 5 · demo_natToReal_add 定理
    theorem demo_natToReal_add :
    addRel (natToReal 1) (natToReal 2) (natToReal 3) :=
  natToReal_add 1 2
    练习 6 · demo_add_unique 定理

    1 + 2 的输出，就与 natToReal 3 相等。

    theorem demo_add_unique (c : Real)
    (h : addRel (natToReal 1) (natToReal 2) c) :
    c = natToReal 3 :=
  addRel_unique (natToReal 1) (natToReal 2) c (natToReal 3)
    h (natToReal_add 1 2)

    数系综合：商的代价——一座桥与两座桥

    6 道练习 · 6 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · quot_lift_mk 定理

    Quot.lift : (f : α → β) → (∀ a b, r a b → f a = f b) → Quot r → β 当 β = Rat（一个 Type），lift 的返回值仍是元素，义务只有一条： 换代表元后像相等（69.2 的 intToRatRep_wd）。；当 β = Real → Prop（61 的加法关系、66 的序），外层 lift 的 f 是 Real → (Real → Prop)，于是「换代表元后像相等」变成了函数 相等：把函数相等化成逐点相等要 funext，每个点上的命题相等要 propext。这正是 61/66 两个 def 里的两次 Quot.lift 与两条 外延义务。 两件代价都不是新公理：funext 在本课程 本课程 是从 Quot.sound 证出的 定理（lib.Extensionality），propext 是 本课程 已声明的既有 axiom （只在 Prop 层用）。所以「ℝ 的加法是关系而不是函数」不是绕路： addRel a b c 正是两次 lift 之后能诚实拿到的全部。 Quot.lift 作用在 Quot.mk a 上按 ι 归约成 f a，两边定义性相等。

    theorem quot_lift_mk (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop)
    (f : α → β) (h : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b) (a : α) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f h (@Quot.mk.{1} α r a) = f a :=
  @Eq.refl.{1} β (f a)
    练习 2 · quot_lift_unique 定理

    先 funext 把函数相等化成逐点相等，再 Quot.ind 把商点烧成 mk a；两次 ι 归约后目标就是 f a = g a，交给逐点假设。

    theorem quot_lift_unique (α β : Type) (r : α → α → Prop)
    (f g : α → β)
    (hf : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → f a = f b)
    (hg : ∀ (a b : α), r a b → g a = g b)
    (h : ∀ (a : α), f a = g a) :
    @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf = @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg :=
  funext
    (@Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf)
    (@Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg)
    (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) =>
      @Quot.ind.{1} α r
        (fun (q : @Quot.{1} α r) =>
          @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β f hf q =
          @Quot.lift.{1, 1} α r β g hg q)
        (fun (a : α) => h a)
        q)
    练习 3 · intToRat_sound 定理

    intToRat 作用在 mk p 上按 ι 归约成 Quot.mk ratRel (intToRatRep p)； 于是 Quot.sound 把 intToRatRep_wd 直接升级成商里的相等。

    theorem intToRat_sound (p q : Prod Nat Nat) (h : intRel p q) :
    intToRat (@Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel p) =
    intToRat (@Quot.mk.{1} (Prod Nat Nat) intRel q) :=
  @Quot.sound.{1} ratRep ratRel (intToRatRep p) (intToRatRep q)
    (intToRatRep_wd p q h)
    练习 4 · addRel_congr 定理

    addRel 不是函数，不能 congrArg；但三个参数都是相等可替换的。 从右到左搬：先 c，再 b，最后 a。

    theorem addRel_congr (a a' b b' c c' : Real)
    (h : addRel a b c) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c') :
    addRel a' b' c' :=
  @Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel a' b' x) c c' hc
    (@Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel a' x c) b b' hb
      (@Eq.subst.{1} Real (fun (x : Real) => addRel x b c) a a' ha h))
    练习 5 · addRel_total_on_cauchy 定理

    输出取 Real.mk (addSeq x y)；addRel_intro 正好给出这个三元组。

    theorem addRel_total_on_cauchy (x y : Seq) (hx : Cauchy x) (hy : Cauchy y) :
    ∃ (c : Real), addRel (Real.mk x) (Real.mk y) c :=
  Exists.intro (Real.mk (addSeq x y)) (addRel_intro x y hx hy)
    练习 6 · demo_addRel_exists_unique 定理
    theorem demo_addRel_exists_unique :
    ∃ (c : Real),
      addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) c ∧
        ∀ (c' : Real),
          addRel (Real.mk zeroSeq) (Real.mk zeroSeq) c' → c' = c :=
  addRel_exists_unique zeroSeq zeroSeq cauchy_zero cauchy_zero

    数系综合：完备性盘点——代表元层与集合层

    5 道练习 · 5 份按名匹配的解答

    练习 1 · upperBound_nonpos 定理

    展开 UpperBound 后目标就是 ∀ x, realLe x zeroReal → realLe x zeroReal。

    theorem upperBound_nonpos :
    UpperBound (fun (x : Real) => realLe x zeroReal) zeroReal :=
  fun (x : Real) (h : realLe x zeroReal) => h
    练习 2 · least_nonpos 定理
    theorem least_nonpos (b : Real)
    (hb : UpperBound (fun (x : Real) => realLe x zeroReal) b) :
    realLe zeroReal b :=
  hb zeroReal
    (Iff.mpr (realLe_mk zeroSeq zeroSeq)
      (realLeRep_refl zeroSeq cauchy_zero))
    练习 3 · hasLUB_nonpos 定理

    HasLUB 是一个 ∃ b；见证取 zeroReal，两部分交给 72.2 与 72.3。 这里没有 Classical.choice：见证是显式给出的。

    theorem hasLUB_nonpos :
    HasLUB (fun (x : Real) => realLe x zeroReal) :=
  Exists.intro zeroReal (And.intro upperBound_nonpos least_nonpos)
    练习 4 · const_tends_to_class 定理
    theorem const_tends_to_class (q : ratRep) :
    TendsTo (constSeq q) (constSeq q) :=
  cauchy_tends_to_class (constSeq q) (cauchy_const q)
    练习 5 · demo_const_tends_to_one 定理

    把 72.5 用在 q := qrep 1 0 0 上（分母字段 0 就是分母 1）。

    theorem demo_const_tends_to_one :
    TendsTo (constSeq (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero))
      (constSeq (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)) :=
  const_tends_to_class (qrep 1 Nat.zero Nat.zero)
